review_scope: Every English source field and its final localized replacement reviewed, including all ten articles, section headings, numeric examples, FAQ questions and answers, and navigation labels. Source and raw target hashes verified when creating corrections.

corrections.source: KakoBuy spreadsheet FAQ
corrections.translation: Pertanyaan umum tentang spreadsheet produk KakoBuy

corrections.source: Sellers can use common imagery. Compare their shop names, IDs, option names and size charts separately. Keep a screenshot under the listing it came from even when another page shows the same garment.
corrections.translation: Beberapa penjual bisa memakai gambar yang sama. Bandingkan nama dan ID toko, teks varian, serta tabel ukurannya satu per satu. Simpan tangkapan layar bersama penawaran asal meskipun toko lain menampilkan pakaian yang sama.

corrections.source: Specify the purpose. A neckline size label shows the marked size; a care label may provide composition or care instructions. Ask for a full view in context and a close-up with legible text.
corrections.translation: Sebutkan tujuan Anda. Label di kerah bisa menunjukkan ukuran tertulis; label perawatan bisa mencantumkan bahan atau cara merawat. Minta foto letak label dan foto dekat yang tulisannya terbaca.

corrections.source: Request the garment laid flat and relaxed, with the tape crossing between the corresponding underarm seam points. Both ends and the units should be visible in one frame.
corrections.translation: Minta pakaian dibentangkan rata tanpa ditarik. Pita harus menghubungkan titik jahitan bawah ketiak kiri dan kanan. Kedua ujung serta satuannya perlu terlihat dalam satu foto.

corrections.source: Ask for one label per shoe with the printed size and sizing system in focus. Save each picture under its left or right identifier. Watch for EU, US and UK sizes sharing one label.
corrections.translation: Minta satu foto label untuk setiap sepatu, dengan angka ukuran dan sistemnya tampak jelas. Tandai kiri atau kanan. Ukuran EU, US, dan UK dapat tercetak bersamaan pada satu label.

corrections.source: Choose a detail before opening a gallery. For the overshirt, the relevant question might be whether a button sits on each cuff or whether the cuff closes with a snap. Look for an angle where the closure is open and the inside surface is visible. A front photograph with the sleeves folded underneath may show the cloth colour and approximate cut while telling you nothing about either cuff. Describe what is visible separately from what you infer from the seller description.
corrections.translation: Tentukan dahulu apa yang ingin Anda lihat. Apakah manset kemeja luar memakai kancing biasa atau kancing tekan? Cari sudut yang memperlihatkan manset terbuka dan bagian dalamnya. Foto depan dengan lengan terlipat di bawah baju mungkin menunjukkan warna dan potongan, tetapi tidak menjawab pertanyaan mengenai manset. Pisahkan pengamatan dari perkiraan berdasarkan deskripsi penjual.

corrections.source: Open the listing and choose a colour while holding size constant. Observe whether the image, available sizes, price or quantity changes. Now change size and repeat. Two almost identical labels can refer to different fabric, an earlier model or a version sold without accessories. Keep the original seller wording as well as any translation. The word black alone rarely distinguishes two black choices if the seller uses a suffix to separate them.
corrections.translation: Pilih warna dengan ukuran tetap, lalu amati apakah foto, ukuran tersedia, harga, atau jumlah berubah. Ulangi dengan mengubah ukuran. Dua nama yang hampir sama dapat menandai bahan berbeda, model lama, atau barang tanpa aksesori. Simpan nama asli dan terjemahannya. Jika ada dua pilihan hitam, akhiran pada nama bisa menjadi pembeda penting.

corrections.source: Suppose you are comparing two canvas bags that share one marketplace link. The seller offers short and long handles in two colours, then a separate choice between a bag alone and a bag with a removable pouch. Choosing green does not settle the handle length or whether you are buying a pouch. Read through all visible selectors after making a colour choice. Some combinations may disappear or change names as a result of the preceding selection. Save the complete final wording in the order the seller displays it.
corrections.translation: Dua tas kanvas bisa memakai tautan yang sama. Penjual menawarkan pegangan pendek atau panjang dalam dua warna, lalu pilihan tas saja atau bersama kantong lepas. Memilih hijau belum menentukan panjang pegangan ataupun isi paket. Tinjau kembali semua pilihan setelah memilih warna. Beberapa kombinasi dapat hilang atau berganti nama. Simpan teks akhir sesuai urutan yang ditampilkan.

corrections.source: Start with the specific product rather than the platform homepage, an affiliate registration page or a search results page. Open the product normally and look for an original listing link. On this grid, use the source-link control on the detail page when it is available. Copy the resulting address to a private note. If the destination is simply a shop, return to the item and identify the product inside that shop before doing a QC lookup.
corrections.translation: Buka barang tertentu, bukan beranda, pendaftaran afiliasi, atau hasil pencarian. Cari tautan asli pada halaman produk. Pada Sheet Grid gunakan tombol tautan sumber; sesudah dibuka, pastikan Anda benar-benar melihat barang yang dimaksud.

corrections.source: A seller may remove a product or restrict what an anonymous visitor can see. Record the page state and date. If a visual search returns another shop, create a new entry instead of replacing the old source link under the same name. The new listing needs its own price, size, option and QC checks. An old warehouse album attached to the first seller cannot establish what the second seller will deliver.
corrections.translation: Penjual dapat menghapus produk atau membatasi akses bagi pengunjung tanpa akun. Catat keadaan halaman dan tanggal. Jika pencarian gambar menemukan toko lain, buat entri baru. Barang yang tampak sama belum tentu berasal dari sumber lama, memiliki varian yang sama, atau dijual dengan syarat yang sama.

corrections.source: A different buyer may care primarily about strap attachment. For that buyer, an image of a metal ring stitched through a reinforced tab is more useful than a close view of the front graphic. Check both attachment points where possible and identify which listing supplied each view. The most helpful comparison depends on the intended use. A longer checklist of unrelated visual similarities can make two listings seem well researched while leaving the one purchasing requirement completely unanswered.
corrections.translation: Bagi pembeli yang memprioritaskan tali, foto cincin logam pada lidah kain berjahitan penguat lebih berguna daripada gambar depan. Periksa kedua titik pengait jika terlihat dan catat apakah talinya lepas-pasang. Foto dari satu sisi saja belum menjawab keadaan sisi lainnya.

corrections.source: Read measurements with similar care. A chart headed “approximate outer size” describes a different measurement from “usable opening.” If a screenshot cuts off the chart heading or its unit, obtain the full chart before comparing numbers. The better documented listing might offer fewer illustrations and still answer more of your actual questions. Conversely, a detailed specification can identify a potential fit problem even when every photograph looks visually identical to a product you previously purchased from another source.
corrections.translation: Baca judul dan satuan tabel ukuran. “Perkiraan ukuran luar” mengukur hal berbeda dari “bukaan yang dapat digunakan”. Jika tangkapan layar memotong judul atau satuan, carilah tabel lengkap sebelum membandingkan agar dua angka yang berbeda arti tidak tertukar.

corrections.source: If you purchase one version, add an observation about your own received unit beneath that seller's record. A photograph of the bag open with the stated contents visible can answer questions about the unit you received. It does not retrospectively verify another listing. Over time, this practice produces a small collection of comparable evidence with dates and option labels. When someone asks whether a visually similar find is the same product, you can point to the precise features established and the comparisons still missing.
corrections.translation: Sesudah membeli, simpan pengamatan tentang unit sendiri di bawah catatan penjual yang benar. Foto tas terbuka dengan isinya terlihat dapat menjawab apa yang diterima. Bukti itu berlaku untuk unit dan pesanan tersebut; penawaran toko lain tetap memerlukan pemeriksaannya sendiri.

corrections.source: Describe what must be legible. A photograph taken square to the label under even lighting can reveal more than a high-resolution picture taken at a steep angle. Ask that folds are opened without tearing stitching. If the print is tiny, request a contextual photograph and one close view. Make sure both belong to the same warehouse entry, especially when your order includes two nearly identical colours.
corrections.translation: Sebutkan teks yang perlu terlihat. Foto tegak lurus dengan cahaya rata dapat lebih jelas daripada foto beresolusi tinggi dari sudut miring. Minta lipatan dibuka tanpa merusak jahitan. Untuk huruf kecil, gunakan satu foto konteks dan satu foto dekat. Cocokkan keduanya dengan catatan gudang yang sama.

corrections.source: When the missing text does matter, keep the request narrow. Ask for the full composition label on the navy jacket, including the shell and lining headings, with the tag unfolded enough to read both sections. Check any available service terms or price before requesting a paid detail view. After the new image arrives, add it beside the original rather than deleting the first image. The pair documents what prompted your question and which detail eventually resolved it.
corrections.translation: Jika teks terpotong penting, minta foto label bahan jaket biru dongker yang terbuka hingga judul bahan luar dan lapisan dalam terbaca. Periksa syarat dan biaya jika foto detail berbayar. Simpan foto baru di samping foto lama agar bukti pertama tetap tersedia.

corrections.source: A single readable size label establishes a marking on one shoe. Ask for each label if size mismatch is the concern, and note the sizing system rather than comparing bare numbers. A US marking and a UK marking on the same label can be different without showing a mismatch. Compare the equivalent line on the left and right shoes against the option recorded in the order.
corrections.translation: Satu label yang terbaca hanya membuktikan tanda pada satu sepatu. Untuk dugaan ukuran tidak sepasang, periksa label kiri dan kanan secara terpisah. Cantumkan sistemnya. Angka US dan UK pada label yang sama memang dapat berbeda. Bandingkan baris yang setara dengan pesanan.

corrections.source: If internal length matters and the insole is removable, ask whether removal is appropriate before requesting a measurement. A tape laid along the outside sole measures another object. Specify the endpoints, units and which shoe is measured. An insole length provides a physical dimension, but not an assurance of comfort: usable space also depends on shape, thickness and your own foot.
corrections.translation: Bila yang dibutuhkan panjang bagian dalam dan sol dalam bisa dilepas, tanyakan dahulu apakah boleh dikeluarkan. Pita di sepanjang sol luar mengukur hal berbeda. Sebutkan ujung pengukuran, satuan, dan sepatu yang diperiksa. Panjang sol dalam memberi ukuran fisik, sedangkan kenyamanan juga dipengaruhi bentuk dan ruang yang tersedia.

corrections.source: If the order contains two identical-looking pairs in different sizes, keep their warehouse records separate. A shoe box label can provide context if it is clearly tied to the pair in the picture, but boxes and shoes are distinct objects. For a size-sensitive order, ask for the visible size marking inside each shoe and connect the photographs to the correct pair. A combined image showing the two heel openings can help, provided both labels remain legible when viewed at their original resolution.
corrections.translation: Bila dua pasang tampak sama tetapi ukurannya berbeda, pisahkan catatan gudangnya. Label kotak memberi konteks hanya jika kotak jelas terhubung dengan pasangan di foto. Untuk pesanan yang bergantung pada ukuran, minta tulisan di dalam tiap sepatu dan cocokkan dengan baris penerimaan yang benar.

corrections.source: Use an overhead view for alignment, a rear view for heel height and a view of both outsoles for tread pattern. The same camera angle rarely answers all three questions. If the first images already show the tread and shape clearly, a request for another front view adds little. Request the single angle that could change your decision. For an apparent mismatch in heel colour, a view under the same light can be more helpful than a close-up taken in a different room.
corrections.translation: Tampak atas menunjukkan kesejajaran, tampak belakang membantu memeriksa tinggi tumit, dan foto kedua sol luar menunjukkan pola tapak. Pilih satu sudut yang masih dibutuhkan. Jika pola sudah terlihat, foto depan tambahan mungkin tidak membantu menjelaskan dugaan perbedaan tapak.

corrections.source: An accessory can be missing from a photograph, omitted from a selected option, packed out of view or genuinely absent from the received order. Resolve those possibilities in sequence.
corrections.translation: Aksesori bisa tidak tampak di foto, tidak termasuk dalam varian, tersimpan di balik kemasan, atau memang hilang. Periksa kemungkinan-kemungkinan itu satu per satu.

corrections.source: Read the units carefully. A listing might offer a set of replacement clips, a strap sold without clips or a bundle containing both. The order quantity tells you how many units of the chosen offer you purchased. It does not by itself define the number of components inside each unit. Make a short expected-contents list in plain language. For example, one bag, one detachable shoulder strap and two clips already attached to the ends of that strap. Such a description gives the warehouse specific objects to look for.
corrections.translation: Periksa satuan. Satu halaman bisa menjual set klip pengganti, tali tanpa klip, atau paket keduanya. Jumlah pada pesanan menunjukkan banyak unit penawaran yang dibeli, bukan banyak bagian dalam setiap unit. Buat daftar sederhana, misalnya satu tas, satu tali bahu lepas-pasang, dan dua klip terpasang pada tali.

corrections.source: A useful request tells a person holding the item what to photograph, how to position it and which question the resulting frame should answer.
corrections.translation: Permintaan yang berguna menjelaskan barang yang difoto, posisinya, dan pertanyaan yang harus terjawab oleh satu bingkai tersebut.

corrections.source: Begin by finishing a sentence such as “I need this photo to decide whether the folder will fit inside the sleeve.” A question with a concrete decision helps you choose the subject, angle and reference point. If the sleeve opens along one edge, the useful view might show the clear opening between the two zipper stops. A photo of the entire bag laid beside a ruler can look informative while leaving that exact opening hidden by the zipper or by folded fabric.
corrections.translation: Lengkapi kalimat “Saya perlu foto ini untuk menentukan apakah map dokumen muat ke dalam sarung pelindung.” Jika sarung terbuka di satu sisi, ukur celah bersih di antara kedua pembatas ritsleting. Foto seluruh tas di samping penggaris mungkin tampak informatif tetapi belum menunjukkan bukaan yang harus dilalui map.

corrections.source: Use an object and a landmark instead of ambiguous directions. “The inside seam below the left arm when the jacket is worn” identifies a different spot from “the seam on the left of my screen.” Where possible, attach a cropped reference with the area circled and retain a wider view that establishes its location. A close crop of two black seams can be hard to locate on a dark garment. The wide view gives the photographer a way to identify the correct area.
corrections.translation: Gunakan patokan pada barang, misalnya “jahitan dalam di bawah lengan kiri saat jaket dipakai”. Ini berbeda dari sisi kiri layar. Bila memungkinkan, lingkari bagian itu pada potongan gambar dan sertakan tampilan luas. Pada pakaian gelap, dua jahitan hitam tanpa konteks mudah tertukar.

corrections.source: For a flat garment measurement, state the start point, end point and unit. If you want the width across a sweatshirt under the arms, ask to see the garment laid flat, the tape beginning at one underarm seam and ending at the other, with both ends visible. Avoid asking for a fit verdict from a picture. Compare the resulting measurement with a garment you own taken by the same method, and keep any material stretch or garment shape in mind.
corrections.translation: Sebutkan pangkal, ujung, dan satuan. Untuk lebar dada sweter, minta pakaian dibentangkan rata dan pita ditempatkan dari jahitan ketiak ke jahitan ketiak dengan kedua ujung terlihat. Bandingkan dengan pakaian sendiri yang diukur sama. Pertimbangkan kelenturan dan bentuk pakaian saat menilai hasil.

corrections.source: For a small opening, a wide view with both ends of a ruler readable may be more useful than a very tight close-up. A cropped photograph of the number at the far end does not establish the starting point. If a rigid object needs to pass through the opening, distinguish the usable gap from the overall length of the closing hardware. In your note, state which measurement you received. Keep an approximate reading separate from any conclusion about whether the object will fit comfortably.
corrections.translation: Untuk bukaan kecil, foto agak luas dengan dua ujung penggaris terlihat sering lebih berguna. Foto angka akhir saja belum menunjukkan pangkalnya. Jika benda kaku harus melewati bukaan, bedakan celah yang dapat dipakai dari panjang total ritsleting. Catat jenis pengukuran serta apakah angkanya perkiraan.

corrections.source: If the result misses one requirement, quote that requirement and identify what the image did show. For example, the photograph shows the zipper's total length, while the usable opening between the stops remains hidden. Ask for that specific change only if it still matters to the order. If photography cannot settle the issue, consider the seller's written answer, the available order options or declining the purchase. Repeating the same unanswerable request is unlikely to produce stronger evidence.
corrections.translation: Jika satu syarat belum terpenuhi, kutip syarat tersebut dan jelaskan apa yang sudah tampak. Misalnya, foto menunjukkan panjang ritsleting tetapi bukan celah antara kedua pembatas. Mintalah perubahan tersebut bila masih penting. Jika foto tidak dapat menjawab, pertimbangkan jawaban tertulis penjual, pilihan pada pesanan, atau mengurungkan pembelian.

corrections.source: An exchange creates a second physical unit. Keep the original promise, the original problem and the replacement evidence connected without mixing their identifiers.
corrections.translation: Penukaran menghadirkan unit fisik kedua. Simpan kesepakatan awal, masalah pada unit pertama, dan bukti barang pengganti sebagai rangkaian yang saling terhubung, dengan nomor masing-masing tetap terpisah.

corrections.source: A stable marketplace link can lead to a page whose option wording, photographs or price has changed. Compare dated records before deciding what the change means for your order.
corrections.translation: Tautan produk dapat tetap berfungsi walau nama varian, foto, atau harga telah berubah. Bandingkan catatan bertanggal sebelum menentukan pengaruh perubahan tersebut pada pesanan.

corrections.source: A change in translated wording may occur even when the original seller option is unchanged. Compare original text, option code if available, thumbnail, selected unit and live price. If the whole listing now opens at a different default, select the old option manually before drawing a conclusion. A changed default and a discontinued version call for different decisions.
corrections.translation: Terjemahan dapat berubah sementara teks asli penjual tetap sama. Bandingkan teks asal, kode varian bila ada, gambar kecil, satuan penjualan, dan harga terbaru. Jika halaman membuka pilihan bawaan lain, pilih lagi varian lama sebelum menyimpulkan. Bawaan baru berbeda dari varian lama yang dihentikan.

corrections.source: After a received unit is photographed, connect its observations to the paid selection and any approved substitution. Do not promote one order's outcome into a promise that every purchase from the edited listing will receive the same version. If the new option works for your own purpose, state the feature that made it acceptable and retain the related evidence. A future buyer may value a different detail and will be able to judge whether your dated comparison answers their question.
corrections.translation: Hubungkan foto barang yang diterima dengan varian yang dibayar dan penggantian yang Anda setujui. Hasil satu pesanan belum menjamin semua pembeli akan memperoleh versi sama dari halaman yang telah disunting. Jika varian baru cocok, jelaskan fitur yang membuatnya dapat diterima dan simpan buktinya agar pembeli lain dapat membandingkan kebutuhannya sendiri.

corrections.source: Consider an example where one shoe has a dark mark near the heel. Record which shoe and whether the mark appears on the material or only on nearby wrapping. A second image with the wrapping moved away could resolve that ambiguity. It may not identify what the mark is or whether it can be removed. Avoid promising that brushing or washing will solve it. If surface condition affects your purchase, obtain a sufficiently clear view and ask what options are available for this order.
corrections.translation: Jika ada tanda gelap dekat tumit, sebutkan sepatu mana dan apakah tandanya berada pada bahan atau kertas bungkus. Foto kedua setelah pembungkus digeser dapat menjawab lokasinya. Foto mungkin belum mengidentifikasi zat atau apakah dapat dibersihkan. Jangan menjanjikan noda akan hilang setelah dicuci.

corrections.source: A label can answer the question printed on it. Separate marked size, garment measurements and care information so a single tiny picture does not have to carry three different conclusions.
corrections.translation: Pisahkan ukuran yang tercetak, ukuran fisik pakaian, dan petunjuk perawatan. Satu foto label kecil belum tentu dapat menjawab ketiganya.

corrections.translation: Melacak penukaran di KakoBuy dari pembelian awal sampai barang pengganti diterima

corrections.translation: Hal yang perlu diperiksa jika penjual mengubah halaman barang KakoBuy setelah Anda menyimpan atau membelinya

corrections.source: Suppose a seller proposes a more expensive size variant and separately mentions delivery back to the warehouse. Record the item difference and delivery amount as separate fields, even if they later appear as one payment. Check what that payment covers before agreeing. If the transaction appears in another currency, preserve the original amount as well as the amount actually charged. The numbers remain attributable even if your card statement later includes a conversion or a fee outside the seller's quote.
corrections.translation: Jika penjual menawarkan varian ukuran lebih mahal dan menyebut ongkir kembali ke gudang, simpan selisih barang dan ongkir sebagai dua pos. Periksa cakupan sebelum menyetujui meski akhirnya satu transaksi. Bila pembayaran menggunakan mata uang lain, simpan nominal asal dan jumlah yang benar-benar dibebankan agar tagihan kartu dapat dicocokkan.

corrections.source: KakoBuy shopping guides
corrections.translation: Panduan belanja melalui KakoBuy

corrections.source: Check a KakoBuy find against its original listing, selected option and warehouse photographs.
corrections.translation: Periksa barang yang Anda temukan di KakoBuy dengan membandingkan penawaran asli, varian pilihan, dan foto barang di gudang.

corrections.source: What does a KakoBuy QC finder match?
corrections.translation: Apa yang dicocokkan alat pencari foto QC KakoBuy?

corrections.source: A finder can use the underlying marketplace listing to locate photographs linked to earlier orders. First match the marketplace and item ID. Then check whether the pictures identify the same size, colour and version as the one you are considering.
corrections.translation: Alat ini dapat menggunakan penawaran asli di marketplace untuk mencari foto pesanan terdahulu. Cocokkan dulu nama marketplace dan ID produk, lalu periksa apakah ukuran, warna, serta versi yang terlihat sama dengan varian yang Anda pertimbangkan.

corrections.source: Is the number in this catalogue page address the Weidian item ID?
corrections.translation: Apakah angka di alamat halaman katalog ini merupakan item ID Weidian?

corrections.source: The number in a Sheet Grid page address identifies that catalogue page. Open the original seller link and read the itemID value there before using a Weidian QC lookup.
corrections.translation: Angka dalam alamat Sheet Grid adalah pengenal halaman katalog. Sebelum mencari foto QC Weidian, buka tautan asli penjual dan baca nilai itemID pada alamat produk tersebut.

corrections.source: What should I do if an agent link contains an encoded seller URL?
corrections.translation: Bagaimana jika tautan agen memuat alamat penjual yang disandikan?

corrections.source: Open the product normally and use its original marketplace link when available. Compare the destination, shop and item number with the saved row. Avoid guessing which digits in a long agent URL identify the product.
corrections.translation: Buka produk seperti biasa dan gunakan tombol menuju penawaran asli jika ada. Cocokkan alamat tujuan, toko, dan nomor produk dengan baris yang disimpan. Jangan menebak ID produk dari deretan angka dalam URL agen yang panjang.

corrections.source: Can an image match find the exact seller?
corrections.translation: Apakah pencarian dengan gambar memastikan penjual yang tepat?

corrections.source: An image match can suggest visually similar rows. Several shops can use the same photograph. Compare seller identity and marketplace item ID before assigning any historical warehouse photographs to the result.
corrections.translation: Pencocokan gambar menunjukkan produk yang tampak serupa. Karena beberapa toko dapat menggunakan foto yang sama, periksa identitas penjual dan ID produk sebelum mengaitkan foto gudang lama dengan hasil pencarian.

corrections.source: Do older QC photos show the item I will receive?
corrections.translation: Apakah foto QC lama memperlihatkan barang yang akan saya terima?

corrections.source: Earlier photos can reveal what someone received from a listing at that time. Only evidence tied to your own order can show the unit assigned to you. Record the age, option and visible limitations of a reference.
corrections.translation: Foto lama menunjukkan barang yang pernah diterima dari penawaran itu pada waktu tertentu. Gunakan bukti dari pesanan Anda untuk menilai unit yang diperuntukkan bagi Anda. Simpan tanggal, varian, dan bagian yang belum terlihat pada foto referensi.

corrections.source: What does a blank QC result mean?
corrections.translation: Apa artinya jika pencarian QC tidak menghasilkan foto?

corrections.source: It means that search produced no usable reference for your query. Check the marketplace, item number and link type. An empty search does not tell you whether an inspection exists in a private order or whether a product is in stock.
corrections.translation: Pencarian itu belum menemukan referensi yang dapat digunakan. Periksa marketplace, nomor produk, dan jenis tautannya. Hasil kosong tidak memberi tahu apakah pesanan pribadi punya foto pemeriksaan atau apakah stok tersedia.

corrections.source: Can a copied item link preserve my selected size?
corrections.translation: Apakah ukuran pilihan saya tersimpan dalam tautan produk?

corrections.source: Reopen the link and inspect the selectors. If it opens with a default size, save the original option text and your intended size separately. Verify them again in the order summary.
corrections.translation: Buka kembali tautannya dan lihat pilihan yang aktif. Jika kembali ke ukuran bawaan, catat teks varian asli serta ukuran yang Anda inginkan secara terpisah. Periksa lagi pada ringkasan pesanan.

corrections.source: How can I tell whether a row describes a set or a single piece?
corrections.translation: Bagaimana mengetahui apakah penawaran menjual satu set atau satu potong?

corrections.source: Read the selected option beside its live price. Identify the pieces listed for that option and compare them with the summary. A photograph of a model in a matching outfit can represent items sold separately.
corrections.translation: Baca varian yang dipilih di sebelah harga saat ini. Catat komponen yang disebutkan lalu cocokkan dengan ringkasan pesanan. Setelan senada pada foto model dapat dijual sebagai beberapa item terpisah.

corrections.source: Why do two listings show exactly the same studio photograph?
corrections.translation: Mengapa dua penawaran memakai foto studio yang sama persis?

corrections.source: Which clothing label should I ask to see?
corrections.translation: Label pakaian mana yang perlu saya minta untuk difoto?

corrections.source: Does a size tag confirm fit?
corrections.translation: Apakah label ukuran menjamin pakaian akan pas?

corrections.source: Compare the actual garment measurements with a piece that fits. Use the seller's measurement diagram and consistent endpoints. The same marked size can correspond to different patterns.
corrections.translation: Bandingkan ukuran fisik pakaian dengan pakaian Anda yang pas. Ikuti diagram ukur penjual dengan titik awal dan akhir yang sama. Dua pakaian bertanda ukuran sama bisa memakai pola potong berbeda.

corrections.source: How should a tape be positioned for an underarm-width photo?
corrections.translation: Bagaimana posisi pita ukur untuk foto lebar dada dari ketiak ke ketiak?

corrections.source: How can I compare two shoes in a single pair?
corrections.translation: Bagaimana membandingkan sepatu kiri dan kanan dalam satu pasang?

corrections.source: Ask for both shoes together, aligned at their heels and photographed from above. Use additional views to check each label and the feature of concern. A single shoe cannot establish that its partner matches.
corrections.translation: Minta keduanya diletakkan berdampingan, tumit sejajar, lalu difoto dari atas. Gunakan sudut tambahan untuk tiap label dan detail yang dicurigai. Foto satu sepatu saja belum memastikan pasangannya sama.

corrections.source: What makes a shoe-label photo readable?
corrections.translation: Seperti apa foto label sepatu yang dapat diperiksa?

corrections.source: What should I do if an advertised accessory appears to be missing?
corrections.translation: Apa yang harus dilakukan bila aksesori pada iklan tidak terlihat di gudang?

corrections.source: Save the exact option description showing that it includes the accessory. Ask for an overview of the full contents and a check of pockets or inner packaging before reporting a shortage.
corrections.translation: Simpan teks varian yang jelas menyebut aksesori itu disertakan. Minta gambaran seluruh isi serta pemeriksaan saku atau kemasan bagian dalam sebelum melaporkan kekurangan.

corrections.source: Which details belong in a custom photo request?
corrections.translation: Informasi apa yang perlu disertakan saat meminta foto khusus?

corrections.source: Give the order reference, selected option, view required and the decision it will resolve. For measurements, add endpoints and units. Check service availability and the displayed price before confirming.
corrections.translation: Cantumkan referensi pesanan, varian, sudut pengambilan, dan keputusan yang bergantung pada hasilnya. Untuk pengukuran sertakan titik awal, akhir, dan satuan. Periksa layanan yang tersedia serta harga sebelum menyetujui.

corrections.source: Can a warehouse photo confirm the true colour on my screen?
corrections.translation: Dapatkah foto gudang memastikan warna persis seperti yang tampak di layar?

corrections.source: Lighting, white balance and screen settings influence appearance. Compare several views and the seller's colour label. If two options only differ by shade, ask for a view with the identifier visible.
corrections.translation: Cahaya, keseimbangan putih, dan pengaturan layar memengaruhi tampilan. Bandingkan beberapa sudut dengan nama warna dari penjual. Jika varian hanya berbeda rona, minta foto yang menyertakan penanda variannya.

corrections.source: How should I record a replacement order?
corrections.translation: Bagaimana mencatat barang pengganti?

corrections.source: Keep the original case reference and give the replacement a separate entry. Record the replacement's option, intake reference and pictures. Recheck the original problem on the new unit.
corrections.translation: Pertahankan referensi kasus awal lalu buat catatan terpisah untuk pengganti. Simpan varian, nomor penerimaan gudang, dan fotonya. Periksa kembali masalah semula pada barang baru.

corrections.source: What if the seller edits an option after I pay?
corrections.translation: Bagaimana jika penjual mengubah varian setelah saya membayar?

corrections.source: Keep the dated selection screenshot and order confirmation from payment. Compare the received item against that record, then show the changed listing separately when asking for a check.
corrections.translation: Simpan tangkapan layar bertanggal dari pilihan awal dan konfirmasi pembayaran pesanan. Bandingkan barang yang diterima dengan catatan itu. Saat meminta pemeriksaan, tampilkan halaman yang berubah sebagai bukti terpisah.

corrections.source: Should I discard the retail packaging before deciding about an exchange?
corrections.translation: Bolehkah kemasan asli dibuang sebelum memutuskan penukaran?

corrections.source: Ask the applicable service or seller which tags, bags and boxes must accompany the item. Keep those materials until you understand the conditions for the specific order.
corrections.translation: Tanyakan kepada penjual atau layanan terkait label, kantong, dan kotak apa yang harus menyertai barang. Simpan semuanya sampai Anda memahami persyaratan pesanan tersebut.

corrections.source: Where should I take a question about an actual KakoBuy order?
corrections.translation: Ke mana saya mengajukan pertanyaan tentang pesanan KakoBuy saya?

corrections.source: Use the support channel in your KakoBuy account with the purchase or parcel reference. This independent catalogue can help identify a listing, while the account record contains the transaction details.
corrections.translation: Gunakan saluran dukungan di akun KakoBuy dengan referensi pembelian atau paket. Katalog independen ini membantu mengenali penawaran, sedangkan catatan transaksi ada di akun Anda.

corrections.source: Handle accessories packed separately
corrections.translation: Telusuri aksesori yang dikirim terpisah

corrections.source: Check the available remedy
corrections.translation: Periksa pilihan penyelesaian yang tersedia

corrections.source: Reprice an unpaid shortlist entry
corrections.translation: Hitung ulang harga barang incaran yang belum dibayar

corrections.source: Check fit independently
corrections.translation: Nilai kecocokan dengan ukuran fisik

corrections.source: Request an inventory view
corrections.translation: Minta foto barang dan seluruh komponennya

corrections.source: Record the original unit's movement
corrections.translation: Catat perjalanan barang pertama

corrections.source: Close both the item and payment records
corrections.translation: Selesaikan catatan barang dan pembayaran

corrections.source: A number can narrow a search from thousands of similar product photographs to one seller listing. It is most useful when you also retain the marketplace, the selected option and the date of the reference.
corrections.translation: Nomor produk mempersempit pencarian ribuan foto serupa ke satu halaman penjual. Catat juga lokapasar, varian yang dipilih, dan tanggal Anda melihat referensinya.

corrections.source: Identify the number you actually have
corrections.translation: Kenali nomor yang Anda pegang

corrections.source: Start on the purchase page for the product you mean to investigate. Follow the original seller link and record its marketplace. A Weidian listing can carry an itemID value in the seller URL. The smaller number at the end of a Sheet Grid catalogue page identifies a different record. An agent order reference, domestic tracking number and warehouse intake reference also serve different purposes. Keep their names beside them when copying numbers to your notes.
corrections.translation: Buka halaman pembelian produk, ikuti tautan ke penjual asli, lalu catat nama lokapasarnya. URL Weidian dapat memuat itemID. Angka di akhir alamat katalog Sheet Grid merujuk pada entri lain. Nomor pesanan agen, resi domestik, dan nomor penerimaan gudang juga berbeda fungsi. Tulis jenis nomor di sebelah angkanya.

corrections.source: Run a lookup with the source attached
corrections.translation: Sertakan sumber saat mencari

corrections.source: Use the complete source product link where a QC finder accepts it. If a service asks for a marketplace and number separately, use the pair from the same original listing. Save both the search input and the result so another person can reproduce your comparison. A result reached only by typing a broad garment name is a candidate for review. Compare its original seller identifier before attaching the photos to your intended order.
corrections.translation: Masukkan tautan produk lengkap jika alat pencari foto QC mendukungnya. Bila lokapasar dan nomor diminta secara terpisah, ambil keduanya dari halaman produk yang sama. Simpan masukan dan hasil agar orang lain dapat mengulang pencarian. Jika foto ditemukan lewat kata kunci umum, cocokkan dahulu kode barang asli sebelum mengaitkannya dengan pesanan.

corrections.source: Test what the album can establish
corrections.translation: Tentukan apa yang terlihat di album

corrections.source: Suppose the listing has a black jacket and a navy version with a different lining. An old front photograph might confirm the shape of the pockets. Without the option label or a visible lining it cannot settle which version was photographed. Describe the strongest observation you can make, such as two flap pockets visible. Keep a separate note for the unresolved question, such as the material on the inside of the navy version.
corrections.translation: Misalnya, jaket tersedia dalam warna hitam dan biru dongker dengan lapisan dalam berbeda. Foto lama dari depan mungkin menunjukkan dua saku bertutup. Jika label varian maupun lapisan dalam tidak terlihat, foto itu belum membuktikan varian mana yang dipotret. Pisahkan pengamatan tentang saku dari pertanyaan mengenai bahan pelapis jaket biru dongker.

corrections.source: Handle empty and conflicting results
corrections.translation: Jika hasil kosong atau bertentangan

corrections.source: Check the marketplace, the intact item number and whether you copied an item link rather than a shop homepage or an image URL. A finder may have no public album for an otherwise valid listing. If two albums conflict, compare dates, options, packaging and the particular detail visible. A seller can update a listing over time, or a gallery may mix options. Do not average inconsistent evidence into a confident claim.
corrections.translation: Periksa nama lokapasar, nomor barang lengkap, dan tujuan tautan. Anda memerlukan halaman produk; beranda toko atau alamat gambar mengarah ke tempat lain. Produk yang sah pun belum tentu punya album publik. Jika album berbeda, bandingkan tanggal, varian, kemasan, dan detail yang tampak. Halaman bisa berubah atau galeri bisa mencampur beberapa varian. Catat perbedaan sampai ada bukti yang menjelaskannya.

corrections.source: Move from reference to order evidence
corrections.translation: Gunakan bukti dari pesanan sendiri

corrections.source: Before purchase, decide whether the missing detail matters enough to ask the seller or leave the item on your shortlist. After purchase, use the photographs tied to your own order for decisions about the received unit. Retain the older album as a comparison and clearly label its origin. If the new unit differs, identify the specific feature and quote your selected option, rather than promising support that the historical picture describes every item now supplied.
corrections.translation: Sebelum membeli, putuskan apakah detail yang belum jelas perlu ditanyakan atau barang cukup disimpan dalam daftar pilihan. Sesudah membeli, gunakan foto yang terhubung dengan pesanan untuk menilai unit yang diterima. Beri album lama keterangan asal. Jika berbeda, tunjukkan bagian tertentu dan sebutkan varian pilihan Anda saat menghubungi layanan pelanggan.

corrections.source: Make the search repeatable
corrections.translation: Simpan data agar pencarian dapat diulang

corrections.source: Imagine a friend sends a cropped photo of a brown overshirt. The corner shows part of an item number. Searching that partial number might produce a page with an overshirt, but several digits or even the marketplace could be missing. Ask for the product link that accompanied the photo. If your friend only has the image, create a visual-reference note and leave its seller blank. The distinction matters weeks later when you are deciding whether to buy a listing that happens to resemble the picture.
corrections.translation: Seorang teman mengirim potongan foto kemeja luar cokelat. Hanya sebagian nomor terlihat di sudut foto. Pencarian bisa menemukan kemeja serupa meski beberapa digit atau bahkan nama lokapasar masih hilang. Mintalah tautan yang semula menyertai foto. Jika hanya ada gambar, simpan sebagai referensi visual dan kosongkan nama penjual. Beberapa minggu kemudian Anda masih dapat membedakannya dari penawaran yang kebetulan mirip.

corrections.source: A repeatable lookup has a simple test. A second person, given only the public listing reference, should be able to follow the same route to the same offer or report that the offer has since changed. Record the date, marketplace name, complete identifier and public gallery address where available. A friend should never need your account password or access to your payment history to reproduce a public product search. Keep purchase-specific checks in your private order record instead.
corrections.translation: Minta orang lain membuka penawaran yang sama dari referensi publik tersebut. Ia semestinya dapat menemukannya atau melihat bahwa penawaran sudah berubah. Catat tanggal, nama lokapasar, kode lengkap, dan alamat galeri publik jika tersedia. Pencarian publik tidak memerlukan kata sandi ataupun riwayat pembayaran Anda. Simpan data pesanan pribadi secara terpisah.

corrections.source: Check the gallery against a feature you can distinguish
corrections.translation: Pilih detail yang bisa dibedakan di foto

corrections.source: Consider how two photos could disagree without either being altered. A photograph of the brown option may show dark fasteners and one of the cream option may show pale fasteners. The gallery could then contain two visually different cuffs under one marketplace item ID. Check the option tag if one exists. Where it is missing, use the photos to formulate a more precise question for the seller, such as whether the brown option currently has dark buttons at both cuffs.
corrections.translation: Dua foto yang berbeda belum tentu disunting. Varian cokelat mungkin berkancing gelap dan varian krem berkancing terang, meski keduanya memakai itemID yang sama. Periksa label varian. Jika tidak ada, tanyakan secara khusus apakah kemeja cokelat yang sekarang dijual memiliki kancing gelap di kedua manset.

corrections.source: Read dates in context
corrections.translation: Perhatikan arti tanggal yang tercantum

corrections.source: A photograph's publication date and the date a buyer received the item need not coincide. When a finder supplies only one date, write down the label beside the date. Avoid assigning the image to a particular production run unless the source actually supplies that information. If the seller page recently acquired a new colour name, an old gallery result is still a reference for the listing, but the connection to the new option needs separate evidence. Do not rename an older image to match the newer choice.
corrections.translation: Tanggal publikasi foto bisa berbeda dari tanggal pembeli menerima barang. Jika hanya satu tanggal ditampilkan, salin juga keterangan di sebelahnya. Kaitkan foto dengan periode produksi tertentu hanya bila sumber mengatakannya. Jika nama warna berubah, galeri lama masih berguna untuk menelusuri halaman, tetapi kaitannya dengan pilihan baru perlu dibuktikan. Pertahankan nama asli foto lama.

corrections.source: For a simple comparison, write two dated lines. One could say that the album seen on Monday showed a brown overshirt with two visible chest pockets. The other could say that on Thursday the seller offered a brown option whose description mentioned one chest pocket. The two lines preserve the disagreement precisely. A support question can now ask which pocket arrangement applies to the presently selected brown option without arguing about whether the entire listing is accurate.
corrections.translation: Buat dua catatan bertanggal. Misalnya, pada Senin album memperlihatkan kemeja luar cokelat dengan dua saku dada. Pada Kamis, deskripsi penjual menyebut satu saku dada untuk warna cokelat. Anda dapat menanyakan jumlah saku varian cokelat yang sekarang dipilih tanpa mempertanyakan semua informasi di halaman.

corrections.source: Read the gaps in an otherwise convincing album
corrections.translation: Cari bagian yang belum terlihat

corrections.source: Several photographs can all originate from the same unit. Five angles of a garment spread on a green table give more information about that garment, but they do not establish that five buyers received it. Look for shared folds, identical tags and repeated packing labels when assessing the range of examples. Count distinct units only when the source gives you a basis for doing so. Otherwise describe the number of useful views and avoid implying that you assessed a larger sample.
corrections.translation: Lima sudut foto pakaian di atas meja hijau mungkin berasal dari satu unit. Anda tahu lebih banyak tentang pakaian itu tetapi belum dapat mengatakan lima pembeli menerimanya. Cari kesamaan pada lipatan kain, label pakaian, dan stiker kemasan. Hitung unit terpisah hanya bila sumber menyediakan dasar. Jika tidak, sebutkan jumlah sudut yang membantu pemeriksaan.

corrections.source: A series can also omit precisely the feature that matters. A bag might be shown from the front, back and both sides while its interior remains closed. The gallery could resolve whether it has external side pockets and leave the number of interior compartments unanswered. Save the picture that best shows the external pockets. Write down the interior question beside it so the next stage of your research addresses that missing detail instead of repeating a search that has already yielded all it can.
corrections.translation: Foto tas dari depan, belakang, dan kedua sisi dapat memperlihatkan saku luar, sedangkan bagian dalam tetap tertutup. Simpan foto yang paling jelas menunjukkan saku luar. Catat pertanyaan mengenai jumlah kompartemen dalam agar langkah berikutnya menyasar detail yang belum terjawab.

corrections.source: Bring the correct comparison back to your order
corrections.translation: Bawa pembanding yang tepat ke pesanan Anda

corrections.source: Once your own warehouse record is available, start a separate folder or note for the received item. Include the selected option as it appeared on the order, then add your observations about the received unit. If the newly photographed garment has an unexpected cuff, compare its label and the specific closure against the saved seller option. The old public image can illustrate what prompted your initial question. Your paid selection and your own photographs explain the actual order difference.
corrections.translation: Begitu catatan gudang tersedia, buat berkas tersendiri untuk barang yang diterima. Simpan nama varian persis seperti pada pesanan, lalu tambahkan pengamatan. Jika manset berbeda dari dugaan, bandingkan label dan pengancingnya dengan pilihan penjual yang disimpan. Foto publik lama menjelaskan alasan bertanya; pilihan yang dibayar dan foto barang sendiri menunjukkan perbedaan dalam pesanan.

corrections.source: For a message requesting clarification, supply only the pieces someone needs to act. Identify the order privately, name the selected option, describe the visible detail and ask for the missing view or confirmation. A message such as “Please show the open left cuff of the brown overshirt so I can see whether it closes with a button” gives the reader a clear action. If the current photo answers the question, close the note with that observation and its date.
corrections.translation: Kirim nomor pesanan melalui saluran pribadi, sebutkan varian dan detail yang tampak, lalu minta foto yang memberi jawaban. Misalnya, “Tolong tunjukkan manset kiri kemeja luar cokelat dalam keadaan terbuka agar saya dapat melihat apakah pengancingnya memakai kancing biasa.” Setelah terjawab, catat hasil dan tanggal.

corrections.source: A seller can place many combinations on one product page. The marketplace identifier finds that page; a saved selection explains which one of those combinations you wanted.
corrections.translation: Satu halaman penjual dapat memuat banyak kombinasi. Kode barang menunjukkan halamannya, sedangkan pilihan yang Anda simpan menunjukkan kombinasi yang ingin dibeli.

corrections.source: Separate three records
corrections.translation: Pisahkan tiga jenis catatan

corrections.source: Keep the seller listing, the selected option text and the paid order summary. The first record identifies an offer, the second identifies a choice within it, and the third shows what was submitted. An internal stock keeping unit may be visible for some selections. When no SKU is displayed, do not manufacture one by inventing a number or appending a colour name to the item link.
corrections.translation: Simpan halaman penjual, teks varian pilihan, dan ringkasan pesanan yang sudah dibayar. Masing-masing menunjukkan penawaran, pilihan di dalamnya, dan apa yang benar-benar dipesan. Jika penjual menampilkan SKU, salin kode itu. Jika tidak ada, jangan membuat nomor sendiri atau menambahkan nama warna ke tautan.

corrections.source: Change one selector at a time
corrections.translation: Ubah satu pilihan setiap kali

corrections.source: Reopen the copied link
corrections.translation: Buka ulang tautan yang disalin

corrections.source: Copy the source link and open it in a fresh tab. If the page starts at a default selection, the link is useful for finding the listing but does not preserve your choice. Keep the option notes beside it. If a link appears to restore a choice, still confirm the order summary before payment. A prior selection in a shopping session or an edited listing can affect what a returning visitor sees.
corrections.translation: Buka tautan sumber di tab baru. Jika pilihan kembali ke bawaan, tautan itu hanya mengantar ke produk. Simpan varian di sampingnya. Sekalipun pilihan tampak tersimpan, periksa ringkasan sebelum membayar. Pilihan pada sesi sebelumnya atau perubahan halaman penjual dapat memengaruhi apa yang muncul.

corrections.source: Compare options as complete combinations
corrections.translation: Bandingkan kombinasi yang lengkap

corrections.source: Imagine one row showing trousers, a jacket and a complete suit. The cheapest price could correspond to the trousers. Add the exact jacket-and-trousers option before comparing its subtotal with a different shop's full suit. For quantities, record complete sets separately from pieces. Two units of a suit and two individual garments represent different orders even when a cart shows the number two in both cases.
corrections.translation: Misalnya, satu halaman menawarkan celana, jas, dan setelan lengkap. Harga terendah mungkin untuk celana saja. Pilih kombinasi jas dan celana sebelum membandingkan subtotal dengan setelan lengkap di toko lain. Catat jumlah set dan potong secara terpisah. Dua setelan berbeda dari dua potong pakaian walau keranjang sama-sama menunjukkan angka dua.

corrections.source: Match the warehouse entry to the selection
corrections.translation: Cocokkan catatan gudang dengan pilihan

corrections.source: When photographs arrive, identify the order and the option on the received unit. A size label can support a size check, while a picture showing both pieces helps confirm a set. Ask for the missing feature in a new view if the existing picture does not resolve the question. An item ID match is a necessary link in the evidence chain, but it cannot select a colour or count an accessory for you.
corrections.translation: Saat foto tersedia, identifikasi pesanan dan varian barang yang diterima. Label dapat membantu memeriksa ukuran, sedangkan foto kedua potong pakaian membantu memeriksa isi set. Bila belum jelas, minta sudut yang menunjukkan bagian tertentu. Kode produk menghubungkan catatan, tetapi tidak menetapkan warna ataupun membuktikan jumlah aksesori.

corrections.source: Read a listing as a collection of choices
corrections.translation: Baca semua pilihan pada halaman produk

corrections.source: An internal SKU is helpful when the seller actually exposes one. It might identify a particular combination even when two translated option names look alike. Treat it as a literal identifier, including any leading zeroes or letters. A spreadsheet that interprets the value as a number can discard part of it. Store the value as text and reopen the file to confirm it survived. If the seller never displays an internal code, the marketplace link plus the precise option text and dated order confirmation can still be an adequate record.
corrections.translation: SKU internal berguna jika benar-benar diperlihatkan. Dua nama varian bisa tampak sama setelah diterjemahkan, padahal kodenya berbeda. Salin huruf dan nol awal persis seperti aslinya. Simpan sebagai teks di lembar kerja lalu buka kembali untuk memeriksa. Tanpa SKU pun, tautan produk, nama pilihan lengkap, dan konfirmasi pesanan bertanggal dapat menjadi catatan yang memadai.

corrections.source: Observe what the selected price buys
corrections.translation: Pastikan apa yang sudah termasuk dalam harga

corrections.source: At the top of a multi-option listing, a displayed price may be a starting point. Select the exact components you want, then note the amount and quantity alongside that selection. In the canvas bag example, a photo might show the pouch clipped inside the bag while the cheapest choice sells the pouch alone. Copying the headline price beside a photo of the set would produce a misleading comparison. A row labelled “green bag, long handles, pouch included, one set” gives the price a defined unit.
corrections.translation: Harga paling atas dapat berupa harga mulai. Pilih komponen yang dimaksud, lalu catat harga dan jumlahnya. Foto tas kanvas bisa menampilkan kantong kecil terpasang di dalamnya meski harga terendah hanya membeli kantong tersebut. Baris “tas hijau, pegangan panjang, termasuk kantong, satu set” menjelaskan barang yang harganya dibandingkan.

corrections.source: Quantity deserves a separate check. If you want two people to receive one complete set each, first confirm how many bags and pouches one unit of the selected option contains. Place the desired quantity in the cart and inspect the resulting selection and subtotal before deciding. A free-text instruction about including a pouch does not establish that you paid for the option containing it. If the combination you want has disappeared, ask which listing currently offers it and start a new comparison for that listing.
corrections.translation: Jika dua orang masing-masing membutuhkan satu set, periksa dahulu jumlah tas dan kantong per unit pilihan. Atur jumlah di keranjang dan baca kembali varian serta subtotal. Pesan bebas meminta kantong kecil tidak membuktikan Anda membayar paket yang menyertakannya. Jika kombinasi hilang, tanyakan halaman yang sekarang menyediakannya, lalu bandingkan dari awal.

corrections.source: Use translations without losing distinguishing details
corrections.translation: Terjemahkan tanpa menghilangkan pembeda

corrections.source: Machine translation can make two option strings read identically even when the original includes an extra character, a model suffix or a different unit. Save both original labels and your working translations, with the original spelling intact. Note the option order only as a temporary aid. A seller can rearrange choices, so “third tile from the left” may describe the wrong product when you return. An image thumbnail can help locate a choice, but its colour or pictured accessories need confirmation from the selected option text.
corrections.translation: Dua nama pilihan dapat diterjemahkan sama meskipun teks asal berbeda satu karakter, akhiran model, atau satuan. Simpan ejaan asli beserta terjemahan kerja. Posisi seperti “kotak ketiga dari kiri” hanya penanda sementara karena penjual dapat mengubah urutan. Gambar mini membantu menemukan pilihan, tetapi cocokkan warna dan aksesori dengan teks varian.

corrections.source: If the language difference affects a practical decision, make the question concrete. For example, ask whether the two green long-handle options differ in pouch inclusion or in bag dimensions. Include their original option text so the respondent can distinguish them. A broad question asking which version is better may produce an opinion without resolving the specific difference. Keep the answer with its source and date. If it refers to one colour, avoid applying it to every colour on the listing.
corrections.translation: Tanyakan perbedaan yang memengaruhi keputusan Anda. Misalnya, apakah dua tas hijau berpegangan panjang berbeda pada ukuran tas atau keberadaan kantong kecil? Sertakan kedua nama asli. Pertanyaan “mana yang lebih baik?” mungkin hanya menghasilkan pendapat. Simpan jawaban, sumber, dan tanggal. Jawaban untuk satu warna belum tentu berlaku untuk warna lain.

corrections.source: Distinguish the selection from a customer's note
corrections.translation: Bedakan pilihan belanja dari catatan pelanggan

corrections.source: A configurable product sometimes invites a buyer to leave instructions. The instruction and the selected item perform different jobs. The selected option establishes what the cart and receipt describe; a note communicates something you have requested. If you select a short-handle bag and type “long handle please” in a message, the records may point in different directions. Before paying, choose the exact available option or seek a written explanation of how the seller handles the requested combination.
corrections.translation: Pada barang yang dapat dikonfigurasi, varian di keranjang dan pesan pembeli memiliki fungsi berbeda. Pilihan tercatat pada kuitansi; catatan menyampaikan permintaan. Jika Anda memilih pegangan pendek lalu menulis “mohon pegangan panjang”, bukti pesanan bertentangan. Sebelum membayar, pilih varian tepat atau minta penjelasan tertulis mengenai cara memesan kombinasi tersebut.

corrections.source: For a gift with several components, create a short record for each intended recipient. Record their chosen colour, handle length, pouch choice and quantity, even if the marketplace URL is identical for everyone. Confirm the final order has the expected number of distinct lines. Two identical green bags may legitimately appear on one line with quantity two. Green bags with different handle lengths need a way to distinguish those selections in the record you will use at warehouse intake.
corrections.translation: Untuk hadiah beberapa orang, catat warna, panjang pegangan, pilihan kantong, dan jumlah untuk tiap penerima meski URL sama. Periksa jumlah baris akhir. Dua tas hijau identik boleh berada dalam satu baris dengan jumlah dua. Jika panjang pegangannya berbeda, catatan harus membedakannya ketika barang tiba di gudang.

corrections.source: Resolve mismatches at the right level
corrections.translation: Temukan letak ketidaksesuaian

corrections.source: When a received item differs, ask first whether the listing, the selected combination or the received unit is in question. A correct item number with the wrong colour points to an option-level issue. A correct colour with a missing pouch raises a package-content question. An entirely different seller item number is a source-link discrepancy. Each needs different evidence, and naming the precise difference makes a follow-up easier for the person handling the order.
corrections.translation: Periksa apakah masalah ada pada tautan, kombinasi yang dipilih, atau unit yang diterima. Nomor barang benar tetapi warna salah menunjukkan perbedaan varian. Warna tepat tetapi kantong kecil tidak ada menyangkut isi paket. Nomor barang penjual berbeda menunjukkan masalah pada tautan. Jelaskan perbedaan dengan tepat agar petugas dapat memilih bukti yang sesuai.

corrections.source: For the bag example, gather the paid order line showing the pouch-inclusive combination, the warehouse photo showing the bag, and any photograph that lets you inspect its interior. If the bag is closed, describe the pouch as unconfirmed and ask for an open view if available. If a clear view of the contents and an item count confirms the pouch is absent, update the note. Your record now connects the specific option purchased to the specific feature you needed to verify.
corrections.translation: Kumpulkan baris pesanan yang menyebut tas beserta kantong, foto tas dari gudang, dan tampilan bagian dalam jika ada. Bila tas masih tertutup, tandai kantong “belum terkonfirmasi” dan minta foto terbuka. Jika gambar isi serta hitungan unit jelas membuktikan kantong hilang, perbarui catatan. Kini pilihan yang dibayar terhubung langsung dengan bagian yang diperiksa.

corrections.source: An agent link is convenient for checkout. The original marketplace page gives you a separate reference for the seller, the listing identifier and the options you are researching.
corrections.translation: Tautan agen memudahkan pembayaran. Halaman asli di lokapasar memberi acuan terpisah untuk memeriksa penjual, nomor barang, dan varian yang sedang Anda bandingkan.

corrections.source: Work from the item page
corrections.translation: Mulailah dari halaman barang

corrections.source: Recognize an embedded URL
corrections.translation: Kenali alamat yang disisipkan dalam tautan

corrections.source: Some KakoBuy item links include an encoded marketplace address in a url parameter. Percent-encoded characters can make it look unfamiliar: an encoded question mark or equals sign still belongs to the embedded address. A finder may accept the complete agent link directly. Prefer an exposed original-link control when possible, and inspect the resulting destination rather than deleting punctuation until a URL happens to open.
corrections.translation: Sebagian tautan produk KakoBuy menyimpan alamat lokapasar dalam parameter url yang telah disandikan. Tanda tanya atau sama dengan dapat terlihat sebagai kode persen, tetapi tetap bagian dari alamat asli. Gunakan alat yang menerima tautan lengkap atau buka tombol sumber. Memotong karakter sembarangan bisa menghilangkan nomor atau parameter penting.

corrections.source: Verify the recovered destination
corrections.translation: Periksa tujuan tautan yang ditemukan kembali

corrections.source: Compare the seller domain, item number, title, pictures and available options. A convincing title alone is insufficient when several shops sell similarly named items. An agent URL and its seller URL need not look alike, but the marketplace identity and item number should reconcile where both expose them. Save the pair under one note and give the note a recognizable label such as blue jacket with two-way zip.
corrections.translation: Cocokkan domain penjual, nomor barang, judul, foto, dan pilihan yang tersedia. Judul serupa muncul di banyak toko. Alamat agen dan alamat penjual dapat terlihat sangat berbeda, tetapi harus mengarah pada produk yang sama. Misalnya, periksa itemID pada halaman Weidian bersama dengan detail yang terlihat.

corrections.source: Distinguish useful metadata from private order information
corrections.translation: Pisahkan data produk publik dari data pesanan pribadi

corrections.source: A public listing reference is usually sufficient for comparing a find. Do not share an account dashboard URL, a checkout page containing personal information or a screenshot with an address to prove a simple listing match. Crop any evidence you share to the item and option. An exchange or payment inquiry belongs in the official order channel, where the corresponding order reference can be supplied privately.
corrections.translation: Tautan produk publik biasanya cukup untuk membandingkan temuan. Hindari membagikan dasbor akun, halaman pembayaran yang memuat data pribadi, atau tangkapan layar beralamat rumah. Potong informasi pribadi dari foto dan simpan bukti pembayaran di tempat terpisah.

corrections.source: Deal with an unavailable listing
corrections.translation: Jika halaman produk tidak bisa dibuka

corrections.source: Give each address a purpose
corrections.translation: Beri fungsi pada setiap alamat

corrections.source: A public product find can generate several addresses that look plausible in isolation. The spreadsheet has its own page for the item, the agent can show a product detail page, and the original seller lists the product on a marketplace. A link to the product image opens a fourth destination. Use meaningful field names when you save them. “Spreadsheet discovery page,” “agent purchase page” and “original marketplace offer” are more useful a week later than three unlabeled links in a chat.
corrections.translation: Satu temuan dapat mempunyai halaman katalog, halaman detail agen, tautan asli penjual, dan alamat berkas gambar. Simpan tiap alamat dengan label yang sesuai. Halaman katalog membantu menemukan kembali entri, halaman agen membantu membuka pilihan pembelian, tautan penjual menunjukkan penawaran asli, dan URL gambar hanya menunjukkan foto.

corrections.source: A common test is to imagine which page you would open to answer a question about the seller's current options. A standalone image can show the bag pictured in an advertisement. It cannot establish whether the merchant still offers a red version with a shoulder strap. A catalogue card can help you return to the find, but its short description may omit a seller option. Keep the sources that serve each purpose and record which one supplied a particular observation about the product.
corrections.translation: Tanyakan halaman mana yang menjawab pilihan penjual saat ini. Foto lepas bisa menunjukkan tas dalam iklan, tetapi tidak menetapkan apakah ukuran atau warna tersebut masih ditawarkan. Kembali ke halaman produk dan baca pilihan yang dapat dipilih. Simpan foto secara terpisah sebagai bukti visual.

corrections.source: Follow a normal redirect carefully
corrections.translation: Ikuti pengalihan ke tujuan akhirnya

corrections.source: A shared link may go through a redirect before reaching a product. Open it as an ordinary public listing and note the final destination. Read the address bar alongside the actual content on the page. A shop landing page featuring a similar product in a carousel does not identify that carousel entry as the original item. Look for a specific product title, item identifier and selection controls. If you reach a sign-in page, keep the original public reference and note that the destination could not be confirmed from that session.
corrections.translation: Tautan yang dibagikan mungkin mengalihkan Anda lebih dahulu. Buka sebagai pengunjung biasa dan catat alamat akhir bersama isi halaman. Beranda toko yang menampilkan produk serupa belum setara dengan halaman barang. Cari nomor produk serta pilihan yang dapat dibuka sebelum menandainya sebagai sumber.

corrections.source: Avoid sending an entire browser or order export to someone who only needs to identify a product. If the item link lives inside a purchase history, use the public product or original link control and check its destination before sharing. A screenshot of the whole order history may include unrelated products, names or payment details. The marketplace label and public item reference normally give another person a much cleaner starting point for an independent check of the seller listing.
corrections.translation: Untuk membantu orang lain mengenali produk, cukup bagikan tautan produk publik. Jika tautannya ada dalam riwayat belanja, gunakan tombol produk atau sumber asli dan periksa tujuannya dahulu. Tidak perlu mengirim ekspor riwayat peramban atau seluruh daftar pesanan.

corrections.source: Recognize a link that opens at the wrong level
corrections.translation: Kenali tautan yang berhenti di tingkat toko

corrections.source: Imagine a short link opens a seller's collection of storage boxes. The image of a green box looks familiar, but selecting it reveals a page with several sizes and lids sold separately. You have found a candidate, not yet a recovered link. Compare its marketplace number with any identifier in the original product record. Check whether the seller name and available configurations align with what you saved. If the original record has no identifier, describe the new link as a possible match and explain the basis.
corrections.translation: Misalnya, tautan pendek membuka koleksi kotak penyimpanan. Kotak hijau terlihat familier, tetapi setelah dibuka tersedia beberapa ukuran dan tutup dijual tersendiri. Anda baru menemukan kandidat. Bandingkan nomor produk, pilihan ukuran, dan isi paket dengan catatan sebelum menganggap sumber ditemukan kembali.

corrections.source: A seller can have more than one listing for nearly identical boxes. One might sell sample units, another bulk sets. A product photo can survive across both listings while prices, quantities and dimensions differ. Using the currently accessible offer as a substitute for the old one may be a reasonable buying decision after a fresh review. Replacing the saved original URL without noting the substitution, however, would assign older warehouse photographs and purchase details to a different commercial offer.
corrections.translation: Penjual bisa memasang dua halaman kotak yang hampir identik: satu untuk contoh satuan, satu untuk paket grosir. Foto dapat dipakai bersama meski harga, jumlah, dan ukuran berbeda. Gunakan nomor halaman yang sekarang terbuka untuk pengecekan, dan tandai sebagai alternatif bila identitas asal masih belum terbukti.

corrections.source: Check what survives when the link is shared
corrections.translation: Uji informasi yang ikut saat tautan dibagikan

corrections.source: If the item opens with a selected size in your session, copy its public address into a fresh tab. See whether it preserves the selected option or returns to a default page. A session can remember choices that are absent from the URL. Ask a collaborator to choose the exact option text in their own session if they need to confirm a price or photograph. Do not assume their first displayed option matches yours merely because the marketplace page has the same item number.
corrections.translation: Salin alamat publik dan buka di tab baru. Apakah ukuran yang tadi dipilih masih aktif atau halaman kembali ke bawaan? Sesi belanja dapat mengingat pilihan yang tidak tercantum dalam URL. Simpan nama pilihan secara terpisah dan periksa lagi sebelum membayar.

corrections.source: For the storage box, keep the length, width, height and lid choice beside the link. If the seller uses a label such as “large with lid,” preserve that exact wording and add the dimensions separately. If the link later shows an amended size chart, the original observation remains traceable to a date. You can then decide whether the current offer still serves your purpose, without having to reconstruct why an earlier buyer associated a particular capacity or price with the shared address.
corrections.translation: Untuk kotak penyimpanan, catat panjang, lebar, tinggi, dan pilihan tutup. Jika varian bernama “besar dengan tutup”, simpan nama persisnya dan tulis ukuran secara terpisah. Bila kelak halaman menampilkan tutup lain, catatan itu membedakan pilihan terdahulu dari penawaran terbaru.

corrections.source: Leave a useful result when recovery fails
corrections.translation: Simpan hasil meski sumber belum ditemukan

corrections.source: A useful record can end with an unresolved source. Write down the last confirmed public location and what stopped the search, such as a removed product page or a redirect to a shop. Keep any item identifier you can independently read from the original link. Distinguish a seller claim that the item moved from a verified replacement link that the seller supplied. If you later receive that replacement, open a separate record and connect the two with the date and explanation.
corrections.translation: Catatan tetap berguna meski sumber belum pasti. Tulis lokasi publik terakhir yang terkonfirmasi dan hambatannya, misalnya produk dihapus atau tautan berakhir di beranda toko. Simpan kode yang dapat diverifikasi secara mandiri. Tandai temuan visual di toko lain sebagai calon pengganti.

corrections.source: Before using a recovered link to make a purchase, review the current price, package quantity and selected option. A recovered historical URL answers the question of where the original find pointed. The product offered there today still merits its own review. For a purchase already in progress, use the order's private support channel and attach only the relevant original and current product evidence. A public QC search and an account-specific order question can then be resolved independently.
corrections.translation: Sebelum membeli lewat tautan yang ditemukan kembali, periksa harga sekarang, isi paket, dan varian. Tautan lama menjawab ke mana penemuan awal mengarah. Barang yang ditawarkan sekarang mungkin sudah berubah, sehingga informasi saat pembelian perlu disimpan tersendiri.

corrections.source: Identical studio images can lead to different shops, sizes and packages. Compare what each seller actually offers before using a visual match as evidence about the goods.
corrections.translation: Foto studio identik dapat mengarah ke toko, ukuran, dan isi paket berbeda. Bandingkan apa yang benar-benar ditawarkan penjual sebelum menyimpulkan barangnya sama.

corrections.source: Start with the source pair
corrections.translation: Mulai dari kedua tautan penjual

corrections.source: Save both seller links and identify their marketplace listing numbers. A repeat of the same listing across two catalogue pages is different from two separate sellers reusing a studio image. If the links point to one listing, investigate whether your notes refer to different options or snapshots taken at different dates. If the listings differ, keep two independent evidence records even if the thumbnail is identical down to the background.
corrections.translation: Simpan kedua tautan dan nomor produk lokapasarnya. Dua entri katalog yang menaut ke halaman sama berbeda dari dua penjual yang memakai foto sama. Jika kodenya sama, bandingkan varian, tanggal, dan jumlah sebelum mencari perbedaan pada barang.

corrections.source: Look past the most recognizable feature
corrections.translation: Periksa detail selain gambar depan

corrections.source: A front graphic, colour or model pose works well for finding candidates. It is less useful for deciding whether the construction is the same. Compare objective features such as pocket shape, number of seams, lining, fastening direction and the position of a label. A wide shot establishes where that feature sits; a close detail view can then show its construction. Mark an unseen feature as unknown.
corrections.translation: Gambar depan, warna, atau pose model membantu menemukan kandidat. Untuk membandingkan konstruksi, perhatikan bentuk saku, jumlah jahitan, lapisan dalam, dan jenis pengancing. Catat bagian yang tidak terlihat. Kekosongan pada foto belum membuktikan suatu fitur tidak ada.

corrections.source: Compare the selling unit and size system
corrections.translation: Bandingkan satuan penjualan dan sistem ukuran

corrections.source: One listing might offer a single sweatshirt while the other offers a sweatshirt and matching trousers. Read the option description, quantity and subtotal after making the intended selection on both pages. Then compare size charts using the same measurement paths. A medium in one seller's pattern can differ from a medium on another page even when the photograph displays the same model.
corrections.translation: Satu halaman mungkin menjual atasan saja, sedangkan halaman lain menawarkan atasan dan celana senada. Pilih kombinasi yang dimaksud pada keduanya lalu periksa deskripsi, jumlah, dan subtotal. Bandingkan tabel ukuran beserta satuannya. Label M dari satu penjual belum otomatis setara dengan M dari penjual lain.

corrections.source: Keep warehouse pictures with their source
corrections.translation: Simpan foto gudang bersama sumbernya

corrections.source: A warehouse image found for seller A is evidence about the photographed unit from that listing. Do not move it into seller B's folder simply because the studio photographs match. If a gallery does not identify its source or option, keep its status clear. It might help you recognize a design detail to investigate, but does not resolve whether the seller you are considering currently supplies that detail.
corrections.translation: Foto gudang untuk penjual A memberi bukti mengenai unit yang difoto dari halaman A. Jangan memindahkannya ke berkas penjual B hanya karena foto studio sama. Bila sumber atau variannya tidak tercantum, tandai sebagai referensi yang belum terverifikasi.

corrections.source: Decide what further evidence would change your choice
corrections.translation: Tentukan bukti yang dapat mengubah pilihan

corrections.source: Identify the one difference that matters. If you need a lined garment, a picture of the inside of the chosen version may settle the question. If you care about sleeve length, ask for the measurement and defined endpoints. Keep the two offers separate until the evidence answers that decision. A lower displayed price has little meaning until both columns describe the same contents, options and units.
corrections.translation: Tentukan satu perbedaan yang penting. Jika Anda perlu pelapis, minta foto bagian dalam varian tersebut. Jika panjang lengan menentukan, tanyakan angka serta titik awal dan akhirnya. Pisahkan pertanyaan yang belum terjawab dari hal yang sudah ditunjukkan foto.

corrections.source: Classify what kind of image you are comparing
corrections.translation: Kenali jenis gambar yang dibandingkan

corrections.source: A studio image usually tries to communicate an overall look. It may include a model, decorative props, coordinated garments or multiple colourways. A diagram can communicate dimensions or show a feature from a useful angle. A warehouse picture can show a particular unit after it was received.
