When comparing listings with the same thumbnail, write the origin of each image beside your observation. A denim jacket photographed with a matching belt does not establish that the belt ships with every version of the jacket.
corrections.translation: Foto studio menunjukkan tampilan umum dan dapat memuat model, properti, pakaian pelengkap, atau beberapa warna. Diagram dapat menjelaskan ukuran atau bentuk suatu bagian. Foto gudang mendokumentasikan unit yang diterima. Pilih gambar yang cocok dengan pertanyaan dan jangan menganggap semua properti dalam iklan ikut dijual.

corrections.source: A recognisable background can help you see that two images share the same underlying photograph. The same crease on a sleeve or identical reflection on a buckle gives you a clue. The clue relates to the image, not automatically to the identity of a supplier or the construction of the goods. Two shops may make different claims beside the same photograph. Compare those claims on their own terms and give more weight to evidence attached to the exact option being considered.
corrections.translation: Lipatan pada lengan atau pantulan identik di gesper dapat menunjukkan bahwa dua iklan menggunakan foto dasar yang sama. Temuan itu menjelaskan asal gambarnya. Untuk menyimpulkan barang atau pabriknya juga sama, Anda masih memerlukan bukti tentang produk.

corrections.source: Pick details that change your buying decision
corrections.translation: Fokus pada detail yang menentukan pembelian

corrections.source: Suppose you need a work bag that fits a document folder without folding it. A side-by-side view of two matching front graphics will do little to answer your question. Look for internal opening width, usable depth, zipper shape and the position of any central divider. A listed exterior width might include thick sides or tapered corners. Ask for the particular dimension that controls whether the folder slides through the opening. Keep the folder dimensions beside your notes so the question has a defined purpose.
corrections.translation: Untuk tas kerja yang harus memuat map dokumen tanpa dilipat, gambar depan yang sama kurang membantu. Periksa lebar bukaan, kedalaman yang dapat dipakai, bentuk ritsleting, dan apakah lapisan dalam mempersempit ruang. Bandingkan ukuran map dengan bukaan, bukan hanya ukuran luar tas.

corrections.source: Read the specific seller commitments
corrections.translation: Periksa janji tertulis masing-masing penjual

corrections.source: Open both selected options and compare the words describing the contents. One seller may explicitly list a woven strap and an internal pouch, while the second shows both in a product photograph without specifying inclusion. Record the second listing's package contents as unclear. Contact that seller if the difference determines your choice. A positive answer from the first shop cannot resolve the second shop's offer, even if the same photograph and nearly identical product name appear on both pages.
corrections.translation: Buka varian pilihan dari kedua penjual. Yang pertama mungkin menuliskan tali anyaman serta kantong dalam, sedangkan yang kedua hanya menampilkannya dalam gambar. Catat apa yang secara tertulis termasuk dalam paket, apa yang hanya terlihat, dan apa yang masih perlu ditanyakan.

corrections.source: Distinguish a seller change from a product difference
corrections.translation: Bedakan perubahan penawaran dari perbedaan barang

corrections.source: If both links lead to the same marketplace and item identifier, compare the selected options and the dates the pages were captured. A difference in price may arise because one capture shows an accessory, a different quantity, or an earlier version of the offer. If the identifiers differ, keep separate records even when the shop name matches. A seller may create multiple offers with different package quantities or terms while reusing studio assets. Those are different buying choices until the specific details reconcile.
corrections.translation: Jika lokapasar dan kode produk sama, bandingkan varian serta tanggal tangkapan. Harga berbeda mungkin berasal dari aksesori, jumlah, atau penawaran di waktu lain. Catat perbedaan itu dahulu sebelum menyimpulkan kedua barang dibuat berbeda.

corrections.source: A duplicate spreadsheet entry is a further possibility. If both grid cards link through to the same source listing with the same selected option, one set of current seller checks may serve both discoveries. Preserve their discovery links if you want to revisit the categories where you found them. Where the original listing is inaccessible, describe the relationship as unresolved. Guessing from two visually similar cards risks merging unrelated references and makes later order questions harder to reconstruct.
corrections.translation: Dua kartu spreadsheet dapat mengarah pada sumber dan pilihan yang sama. Saat itu satu pemeriksaan terhadap penawaran terbaru dapat dipakai untuk keduanya. Pertahankan kedua catatan penemuan agar jelas bagaimana Anda sampai ke halaman tersebut.

corrections.source: Write a conclusion that another buyer could check
corrections.translation: Tulis simpulan yang dapat diperiksa kembali

corrections.source: An actionable comparison might read as follows. Both listings show the same green bag on a wooden stool. Seller A gives an opening width and includes an adjustable strap in the chosen option. Seller B gives exterior dimensions and does not describe the strap. The folder fit and strap inclusion are therefore unresolved for seller B. This note identifies the shared visual, the facts attributable to each seller and the remaining questions without rating either seller or making claims about stock quality.
corrections.translation: Misalnya, dua halaman memperlihatkan tas hijau yang sama di atas bangku kayu. Penjual A memberi lebar bukaan dan memasukkan tali yang dapat disetel pada varian pilihan. Penjual B memberi ukuran luar saja. Catat apa yang masih perlu ditanyakan sebelum membandingkan keduanya untuk membawa map kerja.

corrections.source: Identify which label you need
corrections.translation: Tentukan label yang diperlukan

corrections.source: For a marked size, request the neckline, waistband or other label showing the garment's size. For care instructions or a stated fibre composition, ask for the relevant sewn-in information label, including the reverse if text continues there. A paper hangtag may contain the shop's stock number but can become detached. A label photographed alone is harder to associate with a specific piece than a view that also shows its position on the garment.
corrections.translation: Untuk memeriksa ukuran tertera, minta foto label di leher, pinggang, atau bagian yang memuat ukuran. Untuk bahan dan perawatan, minta label jahitan lengkap termasuk sisi belakang jika ada tulisan. Label gantung dapat memuat kode stok toko, tetapi dapat terlepas. Sertakan foto yang menghubungkan label dengan pakaiannya.

corrections.source: Ask for readable evidence
corrections.translation: Minta bukti yang dapat dibaca

corrections.source: Read size systems carefully
corrections.translation: Periksa sistem ukuran pada label

corrections.source: Some labels show multiple size systems or a combination of a letter and numbers. Copy the full line before translating it. Compare the seller's selected option and size chart with that line. A reference photo marked XL from an earlier order tells you what was printed on that photographed unit only. It does not establish the fit of the medium currently assigned to your order.
corrections.translation: Label dapat mencantumkan beberapa sistem ukuran atau huruf beserta angka. Salin seluruh baris sebelum menerjemahkan. Bandingkan dengan varian pesanan dan tabel penjual. Foto lama bertanda XL hanya menyatakan tulisan pada pakaian yang difoto saat itu; foto tersebut belum menunjukkan bagaimana ukuran M yang Anda pertimbangkan akan terasa saat dipakai.

corrections.source: Use a garment you already own as a physical comparison. For a shirt laid flat, you might measure underarm to underarm and back length from a named seam. Record the units and the way the garment was laid out. If the warehouse measurement uses a different endpoint or stretches a knit, repeat the measurement consistently before judging a discrepancy. Do not expect matching letters on two labels to eliminate pattern differences.
corrections.translation: Gunakan pakaian sendiri sebagai pembanding. Bentangkan kemeja, ukur dari ketiak ke ketiak dan panjang punggung dari jahitan yang ditentukan. Catat satuan dan cara membentangkannya. Jika gudang memakai ujung ukur berbeda atau menarik kain rajut, samakan metode dahulu sebelum menyimpulkan ada selisih.

corrections.source: Present a clear mismatch
corrections.translation: Jelaskan perbedaan yang terlihat

corrections.source: If you ordered a particular size and a photograph seems to show a different one, send the selected option and the image together. Explain exactly which marking is unexpected and ask the agent to check the actual unit. A label image cannot establish authenticity, the truth of a composition claim or the durability of a seam by itself. Report the observable difference and retain the response with the item record.
corrections.translation: Jika label tampak berbeda dari ukuran pesanan, kirim pilihan yang dibayar dan foto bersama-sama. Tunjuk persis tulisan yang berbeda dan minta petugas memeriksa barangnya. Foto label saja tidak membuktikan keaslian, komposisi serat sebenarnya, atau daya tahan jahitan. Laporkan apa yang terlihat.

corrections.source: Identify the label that answers your question
corrections.translation: Pilih label yang menjawab pertanyaan

corrections.source: A garment can carry several labels. A neck label can show a brand or a letter size. A sewn-in side label may carry composition and care information. A removable hangtag may show a merchant's stock code, price or barcode. Start by identifying the question and where its answer might actually appear. If your concern is whether a jacket is the ordered size, a clear photograph of a promotional hangtag may be less useful than a readable view of the size marking sewn into the received garment.
corrections.translation: Satu pakaian dapat mempunyai label merek atau ukuran di leher, label bahan dan perawatan pada jahitan samping, serta label gantung untuk harga, kode stok, atau kode batang. Jika ingin memastikan jaket sesuai ukuran pesanan, carilah penanda ukuran pada jaket, bukan sekadar harga pada label gantung.

corrections.source: Labels can refer to different parts of one garment. A coat may have an outer shell, lining and padding identified on separate lines. If a photograph shows one percentage but crops out the part name, resist applying that figure to the entire coat. Request a view that includes both the part description and its composition line. Keep the seller's written specification beside the photo so a difference can be described precisely, for example a discrepancy affecting the lining rather than a general claim about the coat.
corrections.translation: Komposisi kulit luar, lapisan dalam, dan bahan pengisi mantel dapat berada pada baris berbeda. Jika angka persentase terlihat tetapi nama bagiannya terpotong, jangan menerapkannya pada seluruh mantel. Minta foto yang menampilkan nama bagian dan komposisinya. Simpan keterangan tertulis penjual secara terpisah.

corrections.source: Preserve characters that are easy to misread
corrections.translation: Pertahankan karakter yang mudah salah dibaca

corrections.source: The difference between a small and a medium can be a single letter. The difference between two style numbers can be a leading zero, a dash or the final digit. Zoom in on the original file when possible. Upscaling an already blurred screenshot may make text look smoother without revealing the missing character. Transcribe only what you can actually read and mark an unclear position with a question mark. Someone checking later can then focus on that position in a replacement photograph.
corrections.translation: Ukuran S dan M dibedakan satu huruf. Dua kode model dapat berbeda pada nol awal, tanda hubung, atau digit terakhir. Perbesar berkas asli bila tersedia. Memperhalus gambar buram belum tentu menampakkan karakter yang hilang. Salin hanya yang benar-benar terbaca dan tandai sisanya belum pasti.

corrections.source: A folded label can bring two unrelated lines next to each other. For a useful second view, ask to see the label unfolded on a flat surface with the complete text visible, subject to what the warehouse can provide. If the garment has several language blocks, look for a complete block rather than assembling percentages from fragments of different ones. Save the original image alongside any personal translation or cropped reference. This keeps the source available if a later reader questions a character or interpretation.
corrections.translation: Lipatan bisa mempertemukan dua baris yang tidak berkaitan. Bila gudang dapat membantu, mintalah label dibentangkan rata dan seluruh teks masuk bingkai. Jika isinya terbagi menurut bahasa, baca satu bagian lengkap. Simpan foto lama dan foto baru agar konteks perubahan dapat diperiksa.

corrections.source: Use a size label together with a measurement
corrections.translation: Lengkapi penanda ukuran dengan pengukuran

corrections.source: Suppose your order says medium and the sewn-in label also reads medium. That resolves the label comparison. It does not yet answer whether the garment will fit over your usual sweater. Compare the seller's size chart with the measurement you need, observing whether the chart describes garment width laid flat or a body circumference. For a jacket, a tape photograph running straight between underarm points can answer a practical fit question that a perfectly legible size label leaves open.
corrections.translation: Pesanan M dan label M menunjukkan kecocokan penandaan. Untuk mengetahui apakah jaket muat di atas sweter, lihat tabel penjual dan ukur pakaian. Periksa apakah tabel menyebut lebar pakaian dalam keadaan rata atau lingkar tubuh. Foto pita ukur dengan kedua ujung terlihat lebih bermakna daripada label M saja.

corrections.source: If the label says large while the order says medium, save both before deciding how to proceed. A seller may offer a written explanation or an order confirmation may show a different selected option from the one you recall. Record the explanation separately from your initial observation. Avoid overwriting the original selection in your notes simply because someone describes the items as fitting similarly. You may decide a measured garment works for you, but that is a separate decision from whether the label matches the order.
corrections.translation: Jika label L sementara pesanan yang Anda simpan M, simpan keduanya. Penjual mungkin memberi penjelasan tertulis atau ringkasan pesanan menunjukkan pilihan berbeda dari ingatan. Catat penjelasan kemudian secara terpisah. Pertahankan catatan awal agar urutan temuan tetap jelas.

corrections.source: Consider what a label can actually prove
corrections.translation: Pahami batas bukti dari label

corrections.source: A photo can establish what is printed or sewn onto the photographed item when the connection between image and garment is clear. It cannot independently verify a fibre blend, an origin claim or authenticity. For a purchase that depends on a particular material, record both the seller's written description and the wording on the garment. Where the two conflict, ask for clarification before treating either as a confirmed material test. A missing label also leaves the relevant claim unverified in the available photos.
corrections.translation: Jika foto jelas menghubungkan label dan pakaian, Anda dapat menyatakan apa yang dicetak atau dijahit di sana. Foto sendiri tidak memverifikasi campuran serat, negara asal, ataupun keaslian. Jika bahan menentukan keputusan, simpan deskripsi tertulis penjual dan teks label. Tanyakan perbedaan yang konkret bila keduanya tidak cocok.

corrections.source: The context is particularly important with multipacks. One photo of a label on a black T-shirt cannot confirm the labels on two white T-shirts packed alongside it. Decide whether the same evidence is needed for each item. If the order contains mixed sizes, separate each garment by colour and ordered size in the request. A group overview plus a close view linked to each relevant garment can prevent a clear but isolated label image from being assigned to the wrong piece.
corrections.translation: Dalam paket campuran, foto label kaus hitam belum membuktikan label dua kaus putih di sebelahnya. Tentukan barang mana yang perlu diperiksa. Untuk beberapa ukuran, sebutkan warna dan ukuran yang dipesan per barang. Foto kelompok ditambah foto dekat masing-masing menghubungkan label dengan unit yang benar.

corrections.source: Build a clean note for the next decision
corrections.translation: Tulis catatan untuk keputusan berikutnya

corrections.source: A useful clothing-label note can be just a few sentences. Identify the garment and selected option, state the visible wording, identify the unresolved question and specify whether it affects your decision. For example, the paid order says navy jacket, size medium. The label appears to read medium. A number at the bottom is cut off, but you only needed to confirm size. In that case the missing number need not generate another photo request or delay your decision.
corrections.translation: Sebutkan pakaian, varian pesanan, tulisan yang terlihat, dan apa yang belum jelas. Misalnya, jaket biru dongker dipesan dalam ukuran M dan label tampaknya juga M. Angka paling bawah terpotong, tetapi bila yang Anda perlukan hanya huruf ukuran, catat bahwa pertanyaan tersebut sudah terjawab.

corrections.source: A picture of one well-presented shoe cannot establish what is in the other half of the box. A paired inspection starts with identity and finishes with the specific features that affect your decision.
corrections.translation: Foto satu sepatu yang ditata rapi belum memperlihatkan isi separuh kotak lainnya. Mulailah dari identitas kedua sepatu, kemudian periksa ciri yang memengaruhi keputusan Anda.

corrections.source: Start with the pair you ordered
corrections.translation: Mulai dari pasangan yang dipesan

corrections.source: Write down the seller's size system, colour option and quantity. Keep that information with the warehouse entry. The carton label can be a useful cross-check, but it describes the carton. Ask to see the actual left and right shoes together in a frame. If several pairs arrived in one order, do not infer that every image in a gallery belongs to the first row of the purchase summary.
corrections.translation: Catat sistem ukuran penjual, warna, dan jumlah bersama catatan gudang. Label kotak membantu mencocokkan tetapi hanya menjelaskan kotaknya. Minta satu foto yang memuat sepatu kiri dan kanan sebenarnya. Bila beberapa pasang tiba sekaligus, cocokkan setiap foto dengan pasangan dan nomor penerimaan yang benar.

corrections.source: Use a paired view for symmetry
corrections.translation: Gunakan foto berpasangan untuk memeriksa kesimetrisan

corrections.source: For a useful top view, ask for the shoes side by side on the same level surface, heels aligned and toes facing the same direction. Comparing a near shoe with a far shoe in an angled picture can exaggerate apparent size differences. A full back view gives a different comparison of heel height, seam position and colour. Decide which arrangement best displays the suspected issue before requesting more photographs.
corrections.translation: Untuk tampak atas, susun sepatu berdampingan di bidang rata, tumit sejajar, dan ujung mengarah sama. Perspektif miring bisa membuat sepatu yang lebih dekat terlihat lebih besar. Tampak belakang cocok untuk membandingkan tinggi tumit, posisi jahitan, dan warna. Pilih sudut sesuai pertanyaan.

corrections.source: Check each label independently
corrections.translation: Baca label pada setiap sepatu

corrections.source: Define a length question precisely
corrections.translation: Jelaskan panjang yang ingin diukur

corrections.source: Distinguish design from damage
corrections.translation: Bedakan rancangan dengan kerusakan

corrections.source: Some shoes deliberately have asymmetrical panels or different markings on left and right. Compare the official seller option pictures for the specific design rather than assuming every colour patch should mirror its partner. If the concern is a split seam or a scuff, request a focused close-up plus a wider picture identifying its location. Save both beside the purchase record and check the applicable next steps before dispatch.
corrections.translation: Beberapa model sengaja memakai panel atau tanda berbeda antara kiri dan kanan. Bandingkan dengan foto penjual untuk varian tersebut. Untuk dugaan jahitan terbuka atau lecet, minta foto dekat dan satu tampilan lebih luas yang menunjukkan lokasinya. Simpan keduanya bersama catatan pesanan.

corrections.source: Establish which shoe is which
corrections.translation: Pastikan foto menunjukkan dua sepatu berbeda

corrections.source: Two pictures in a gallery do not necessarily show a pair. One could be the same shoe turned around. Begin with a view of both shoes together, with their toes pointing in the same direction. The inside and outside edges should then be easier to distinguish. If one shoe is partly inside the other or the heels are hidden behind packing paper, write down the missing view. A photograph of one excellent lateral profile gives little information about the second shoe.
corrections.translation: Dua foto bisa saja menunjukkan satu sepatu yang diputar. Mulailah dengan foto kedua sepatu bersama, ujung menghadap arah yang sama. Tepi dalam dan luar akan lebih mudah dibedakan. Jika tumit tertutup kertas atau satu sepatu menutupi yang lain, catat bagian yang belum terlihat.

corrections.source: Choose matched views for comparison
corrections.translation: Samakan sudut dan posisi untuk membandingkan

corrections.source: A photograph taken very close to one toe can make it look larger than the other. When comparing toe or heel shape, a matched overhead view with the pair side by side is more informative than two unrelated close-ups. Check whether the shoes sit equally far from the camera and both rest on the same flat surface. Differences in stuffing, lacing and angle can change the outline. Describe the feature you observe before guessing at a manufacturing or handling cause.
corrections.translation: Foto sangat dekat pada satu ujung sepatu membuatnya terlihat lebih besar. Untuk membandingkan bentuk ujung atau tumit, letakkan keduanya berdampingan pada bidang rata dengan jarak kamera serupa. Isi kertas, kekencangan tali, dan sudut kamera dapat mengubah kesan bentuk.

corrections.source: Read size markings without inventing conversions
corrections.translation: Baca ukuran tanpa mengarang konversi

corrections.source: A shoe label may list several regional size systems on separate lines. Transcribe the whole relevant line with its unit or system. A numerical marking from one system and another marking from a different system can look unequal while describing the same paired product. Compare like with like across both shoes and against the seller's selected option. If a label is hidden by the tongue, ask for a view of the label face rather than guessing from the visible end of the number.
corrections.translation: Salin seluruh baris ukuran beserta sistem regionalnya. Dua angka dari sistem berbeda dapat mewakili sepasang sepatu yang cocok. Bandingkan sistem yang sama pada kedua sepatu dengan varian yang dipilih. Bila sistem pada halaman penjual tidak jelas, minta penjelasan alih-alih menebak konversinya.

corrections.source: For practical fit, compare a reference pair you own using the same measurement method the seller describes. A removable insole length and an outsole length are different measurements. A buyer who knows the insole of a comfortable shoe should ask for an equivalent measurement only if the item and service permit it. A photo where a ruler begins outside the heel or follows a visibly curved path can give a misleading comparison. Specify where the measurement should start and finish when the difference matters.
corrections.translation: Untuk memeriksa kecocokan, ukur sepatu nyaman milik Anda dengan metode yang sama. Panjang sol dalam lepas dan panjang sol luar berbeda. Minta ukuran serupa jika barang dan layanan memungkinkan. Penggaris yang tidak dimulai tepat pada tepi membuat hasil sulit dibandingkan.

corrections.source: Distinguish presentation from a physical difference
corrections.translation: Pisahkan efek penataan dari perbedaan fisik

corrections.source: Packing paper can create an apparent bulge and a loose lace can make one opening look larger. For something you suspect to be a physical mismatch, note whether the feature persists across another angle. A shadow at the sidewall in a front view may disappear in a side image. A clearly different tread pattern visible across the whole outsole is a different kind of observation. State the visible feature and ask the person handling the order to check it directly if necessary.
corrections.translation: Kertas pengisi dapat menimbulkan tonjolan, dan tali longgar dapat membuat bukaan satu sepatu tampak lebih besar. Periksa apakah ciri itu bertahan pada sudut lain. Bayangan di dinding sol mungkin menghilang dari samping. Pola tapak yang jelas berbeda di seluruh sol merupakan pengamatan lain yang lebih langsung.

corrections.source: Keep pair condition and box condition separate
corrections.translation: Catat keadaan kotak dan sepatu secara terpisah

corrections.source: A crushed box lid can matter for gifting or storage even if the shoes appear intact. Torn wrapping can be visible without revealing whether either shoe is damaged. Record package condition and item condition separately. If the box is essential, check whether the exact option included the box and whether requested packing services address it before international dispatch. A retailer-style studio photo of a branded box is weaker evidence of inclusion than a written option description or the warehouse's record of what arrived.
corrections.translation: Tutup kotak penyok bisa penting untuk hadiah atau penyimpanan meski sepatu tampak utuh. Pembungkus sobek juga belum membuktikan sepatu rusak. Catat kedua kondisi. Jika kotak penting, periksa apakah pilihan pesanan menyertakannya dan apakah layanan pengemasan yang diminta melindunginya sebelum pengiriman internasional.

corrections.source: When all required views are available, close the inspection with a short statement about both shoes. For example, both labels display the ordered system and size, both outsoles show the same tread and the left heel has a visible mark that still needs clarification. This record is more useful than a single “QC passed” line because it explains the specific checks you completed. Keep the images with the order in case a later packing or exchange question refers to one shoe in particular.
corrections.translation: Akhiri dengan kalimat khusus mengenai kedua sepatu. Misalnya, kedua label menunjukkan sistem dan ukuran pesanan, kedua sol berpola sama, sedangkan tanda di tumit kiri masih perlu diperjelas. Catatan ini menunjukkan persis apa yang sudah diperiksa dan mengapa satu pertanyaan tetap terbuka.

corrections.source: Establish what the option included
corrections.translation: Pastikan isi varian yang dibayar

corrections.source: Find the order confirmation and the selected seller description. Highlight the wording that identifies the accessory, quantity and version. A shoulder bag worn with a decorative strap in a studio photograph might have separate options with and without that strap. A product title saying kit could describe more than one package. Start the inquiry with what the seller offered for the option you purchased.
corrections.translation: Temukan konfirmasi pesanan dan deskripsi penjual untuk pilihan tersebut. Tandai nama aksesori, jumlah, dan versinya. Tali dekoratif yang terlihat di foto tas mungkin dijual dalam pilihan tersendiri. Kata “kit” pun dapat merujuk pada beberapa paket. Mulailah dengan isi yang dijanjikan untuk varian yang Anda beli.

corrections.source: Inspect what the available photo actually shows
corrections.translation: Perhatikan apa yang benar-benar tampak

corrections.source: A closed box or zipped bag is an incomplete view of its contents. Note whether the packaging is open, which compartments are visible and whether an accessory could be wrapped separately. A small cable can sit under a cardboard insert; detachable clips can be inside an inner pocket. Avoid asking the warehouse to break seals or dismantle an item before you understand whether this affects its condition or return eligibility.
corrections.translation: Kotak tertutup atau tas beritsleting belum menunjukkan seluruh isi. Catat kompartemen mana yang terlihat dan apakah aksesori mungkin dibungkus tersendiri. Kabel bisa berada di bawah sisipan kardus dan klip di saku dalam. Ketahui dampaknya terhadap kondisi atau kelayakan pengembalian sebelum meminta segel dibuka atau komponen dibongkar.

corrections.source: Name the missing piece and describe where it may be packed. Ask for an overview with the unit and all loose contents together, followed by a detail view if the shape or connector matters. Give the warehouse entry number so the inspection concerns the unit you actually bought. If another box from the same seller is still in transit, ask whether the accessory is supposed to travel separately.
corrections.translation: Sebutkan bagian yang dicari dan kemungkinan letaknya. Minta foto barang bersama semua komponen lepas; jika bentuk atau konektornya penting, mintalah foto dekat. Berikan nomor penerimaan gudang yang benar. Jika kotak lain dari penjual masih berjalan, tanyakan apakah komponen memang dikirim terpisah.

corrections.source: Write down an evidence-based conclusion
corrections.translation: Simpulkan berdasarkan apa yang dapat dihitung

corrections.source: Suppose your order names a pouch and two clips. The overview shows one pouch, one loose clip and a second clip attached to the bag. That photograph supports a complete count even though only one clip appears loose. In another case a photograph might show unopened packaging and no clips, leaving the count unresolved. Describe what can be counted and what remains hidden.
corrections.translation: Misalnya, pesanan mencantumkan satu kantong dan dua klip. Foto menunjukkan satu kantong, satu klip lepas, dan satu klip masih menempel pada tas. Jumlahnya lengkap walau hanya satu klip tergeletak terpisah. Jika kemasan tertutup dan klip tidak terlihat, jumlah masih belum terkonfirmasi. Catat apa yang terlihat dan apa yang tersembunyi.

corrections.source: Keep the resolution tied to the original purchase
corrections.translation: Kaitkan penyelesaian dengan pesanan asal

corrections.source: If the seller offers to send a missing piece, record its promised description and new domestic tracking number. If an exchange is offered, retain the original item reference and the replacement reference separately. Do not mark the case complete simply because a message promises a shipment. Close the record when the received accessory can be identified and checked against the original option.
corrections.translation: Jika penjual menawarkan pengiriman komponen susulan, catat deskripsinya dan resi domestik baru. Bila ditukar, pisahkan nomor barang lama dari barang pengganti. Janji akan mengirim belum membuktikan aksesori tiba. Tutup catatan setelah barang susulan dapat dikenali dan dibandingkan dengan varian semula.

corrections.source: Establish whether the accessory was included
corrections.translation: Periksa apakah aksesori memang termasuk

corrections.source: A practical accessory check starts with the wording attached to your paid selection. Suppose a bag appears in a studio photograph beside a leather strap, a decorative charm and a dust cover. The actual option might describe only the bag and shoulder strap. Save the option text and any written seller confirmation you relied on. Treat the charm and dust cover separately unless you have evidence that the seller included them in that particular offer. This makes an inquiry clearer and avoids claiming that every photographed prop was purchased.
corrections.translation: Foto studio mungkin memperlihatkan tas dengan tali kulit, hiasan gantung, dan kantong pelindung debu. Teks varian yang dibayar mungkin hanya menyebut tas dan tali bahu. Simpan teks serta konfirmasi tertulis penjual. Anggap hiasan dan pelindung debu sebagai pertanyaan tersendiri sampai ada bukti keduanya termasuk.

corrections.source: Separate an unseen item from a confirmed shortage
corrections.translation: Bedakan belum terlihat dan sudah terbukti kurang

corrections.source: In a first warehouse overview, a strap might be inside the bag, under tissue paper or attached behind the handle. A single photograph of the closed bag cannot establish a shortage. Ask whether the contents can be checked and, if permitted, request a view that shows the open bag and the loose components beside it. Avoid requesting removal of sealed packaging until you understand the implications for that order and have decided that opening it is appropriate.
corrections.translation: Tali dapat berada di dalam tas, di bawah kertas pembungkus, atau tersangkut di belakang pegangan. Foto tas tertutup belum membuktikan kekurangan. Bila diperbolehkan, minta isi diperiksa dan difoto bersama tas terbuka. Pertimbangkan dampak pada pesanan dan ketentuan penjual sebelum meminta kemasan tersegel dibuka.

corrections.source: If an accessory is visible but its identity is unclear, describe it by location and appearance. A narrow black strip seen behind a bag could be a handle, a shoulder strap or a piece of packaging. A photograph of its attachment clips or its full length might distinguish those possibilities. Where access or image quality still prevents confirmation, leave the status as unresolved. The accuracy of the record matters more than reaching a confident conclusion from an ambiguous view.
corrections.translation: Bila yang terlihat hanya potongan hitam di belakang tas, gambarkan letak dan wujudnya. Itu mungkin pegangan, tali bahu, atau bahan kemasan. Foto seluruh panjang atau klip pengait dapat membedakannya. Jika akses atau mutu foto terbatas, biarkan statusnya belum terkonfirmasi.

corrections.source: A seller might send more than one parcel for a purchase. Before assuming a component has been omitted, check the records the order shows for expected domestic deliveries and warehouse intake. Distinguish a seller message saying an item will follow from a shipment reference or intake entry that actually identifies it. If a second package exists, record the reference and what it is expected to contain. Keep the purchase open for the outstanding component until you can evaluate the evidence relevant to your decision.
corrections.translation: Penjual bisa mengirim satu pembelian dalam beberapa paket. Periksa pengiriman domestik yang diharapkan dan catatan penerimaan gudang. Pesan “akan menyusul” berbeda dari resi atau entri gudang yang benar-benar mengidentifikasi barang. Bila ada paket kedua, catat nomor dan isi yang diharapkan, tetap terhubung dengan pesanan semula.

corrections.source: A second domestic tracking event also does not prove the missing accessory is inside. The event identifies movement of a package. The received contents require a corresponding intake record or confirmation. For a bag with a detachable chain strap, you might note that the main bag arrived on one date and the seller described a separate parcel for the chain on another date. Link the second intake to the purchase only once the order record or support response gives you a basis to do so.
corrections.translation: Pemindaian domestik kedua hanya menunjukkan pergerakan paket. Untuk memastikan aksesori di dalamnya, cari catatan penerimaan atau konfirmasi isi. Misalnya, tas tiba lebih dulu dan penjual menyebut paket lain berisi tali rantai. Hubungkan penerimaan kedua setelah nomornya dan barang yang diterima dapat dicocokkan.

corrections.source: Ask for a specific next action
corrections.translation: Minta satu tindakan yang jelas

corrections.source: A useful message includes the selected option, the privately supplied order reference, the component expected and the evidence currently available. You might write that the paid selection says bag with long strap, the overview shows the bag closed and the strap is not visible. Ask whether someone can check inside the bag and confirm the strap before dispatch. This describes a gap and requests a specific action without accusing the seller or warehouse of losing an item.
corrections.translation: Berikan varian, nomor pesanan lewat jalur pribadi, komponen yang diharapkan, dan bukti yang ada. Misalnya, pilihan tertulis “tas dengan tali panjang”, tetapi foto hanya memperlihatkan tas tertutup. Tanyakan apakah petugas dapat memeriksa bagian dalam dan mengonfirmasi tali sebelum dikirim. Anda menjelaskan kekosongan bukti tanpa menuduh.

corrections.source: If support confirms the item was absent, ask which resolution options apply to this order and whether each one involves a deadline, charge or separate shipment. A replacement accessory, a seller inquiry and a return can have different consequences. Record what you actually request and any confirmation received. Avoid combining the missing-strap question with unrelated complaints about colour or packaging in one long paragraph. Separate observations make it easier to see which issues have been addressed and which remain open.
corrections.translation: Bila layanan pelanggan memastikan kekurangan, tanyakan pilihan penyelesaian untuk pesanan ini serta tenggat, biaya, atau pengiriman terpisah. Pengiriman pengganti, pertanyaan ke penjual, dan pengembalian memiliki konsekuensi berbeda. Catat tindakan yang dipilih dan konfirmasinya. Pisahkan masalah tali dari keluhan warna atau kemasan.

corrections.source: Close the record with evidence of the outcome
corrections.translation: Tutup catatan setelah hasilnya jelas

corrections.source: A promise to send an accessory resolves the seller's intended next step. The actual shortage remains open until the promised item arrives or you accept another resolution. Keep the follow-up intake, photograph or adjustment alongside the original order. If an adjustment is offered, record the amount, currency and scope in the private order notes. A statement about one accessory does not automatically explain other charges or establish a general policy for future orders.
corrections.translation: Janji mengirim menjelaskan langkah penjual berikutnya. Kekurangan belum selesai sampai aksesori tiba atau Anda menyetujui penyelesaian lain. Simpan foto, penerimaan susulan, atau penyesuaian bersama pesanan asal. Untuk penyesuaian biaya, catat jumlah, mata uang, dan bagian yang dicakup pada catatan pribadi.

corrections.source: At the packing stage, check that the final parcel request still includes every warehouse item needed for the complete set. If a replacement strap has a separate warehouse reference, attach or select it as the current interface requires. If support says it was already placed inside the bag, save that confirmation. A precise final note can be very short: the black long strap arrived separately, the clips are visible in the new image, and the bag and strap now belong to the same intended parcel.
corrections.translation: Sebelum mengemas, periksa apakah semua barang gudang yang membentuk set tercantum pada permintaan kirim. Pilih atau hubungkan nomor gudang terpisah untuk tali pengganti sesuai antarmuka. Jika petugas sudah menaruhnya di dalam tas, simpan konfirmasi. Catat singkat bahwa tali hitam panjang tiba terpisah, klip terlihat, dan isinya sudah cocok.

corrections.source: Write the decision first
corrections.translation: Mulai dari keputusan yang perlu diambil

corrections.source: Explain what changes depending on the result. You might need to decide whether a jacket has a two-way zipper, whether a printed name is spelled correctly, or whether a sleeve is long enough. The phrase more pictures leaves the photographer to choose an angle. Starting with the decision helps you ask for one informative view rather than several attractive views that repeat the original gallery.
corrections.translation: Tentukan apakah Anda ingin memeriksa ritsleting dua arah, ejaan nama tercetak, atau panjang lengan. Permintaan “tambah foto” membuat petugas harus menebak sudut. Menyebut keputusan membantu memperoleh satu tampilan yang informatif dan menghindari pengulangan gambar dari galeri.

corrections.source: Identify the object unambiguously
corrections.translation: Kenali barang tanpa menimbulkan keraguan

corrections.source: Give the item or order reference and exact option. When two navy jackets differ only in size, a colour name is insufficient. Ask that the item remains identifiable in the picture. For a personalisation check, provide the exact text from the order and specify whether front, back or sleeve should be visible. Avoid including unrelated personal or payment information in the request.
corrections.translation: Beri nomor barang atau pesanan dan varian lengkap. Dua jaket biru dongker dapat berbeda hanya pada ukurannya. Minta agar barang tetap dapat dikenali. Untuk tulisan personal, sertakan teks persis dari pesanan dan lokasi depan, belakang, atau lengan. Hindari data pembayaran atau pribadi yang tidak relevan.

corrections.source: Specify composition and endpoints
corrections.translation: Tentukan bingkai dan titik pengukuran

corrections.source: For a zipper, ask for a closed full-front view with both ends and any sliders visible. For a flat garment width, describe the seam points and ask that the tape's beginning and reading appear in one frame. For a print, ask for a straight-on view that shows placement and another view only if the text is too small. A tightly cropped image may improve legibility while removing the context needed to identify the unit.
corrections.translation: Untuk ritsleting, minta tampak depan tertutup dengan kedua ujung dan semua kepala tarik terlihat. Untuk lebar pakaian rata, sebutkan titik jahitan dan minta pangkal serta hasil pita ukur masuk satu bingkai. Untuk cetakan, mulai dengan sudut tegak lurus. Foto terlalu dekat bisa terbaca tetapi kehilangan konteks barang.

corrections.source: Check the response against the question
corrections.translation: Cocokkan foto dengan pertanyaan awal

corrections.source: Look at the requested feature before scanning the rest of the photograph. Can you see both endpoints? Is the label readable? Is the unit laid flat, or held at an angle that distorts the apparent length? If the image leaves a gap, describe that gap in a follow-up. Asking for the lower slider to be visible is more actionable than saying that the first picture was bad.
corrections.translation: Periksa fitur yang diminta dahulu. Apakah kedua ujung terlihat, label terbaca, dan pakaian diletakkan rata? Jika masih kurang, sebutkan apa yang belum tampak. Meminta kepala ritsleting bawah diperlihatkan lebih mudah ditindaklanjuti daripada sekadar menyatakan foto pertama buruk.

corrections.source: Budget the service and retain the result
corrections.translation: Periksa biaya layanan dan simpan hasil

corrections.source: Check availability, fees and processing information in the current KakoBuy order flow. A third-party article can suggest useful angles, but the conditions attached to your own order decide which request can be fulfilled. Once the image arrives, keep it with the original request and the decision you made. A dated note explaining the accepted measurement remains useful if the item later becomes part of a multi-item parcel.
corrections.translation: Lihat ketersediaan, biaya, dan informasi waktu di alur pesanan KakoBuy saat ini. Artikel dapat memberi gagasan sudut foto, sedangkan ketentuan pesanan menentukan apa yang tersedia. Simpan foto bersama permintaan dan keputusan. Catatan ukuran bertanggal tetap berguna bila barang masuk paket gabungan.

corrections.source: Write the question before selecting the view
corrections.translation: Rumuskan pertanyaan sebelum memilih sudut

corrections.source: An item can invite many interesting close-ups. Prioritise the one detail that determines whether you will accept it. For a garment bought for layering, the flat chest width may be more important than a logo close-up. For a bag bought to replace a lost part, the attachment clip and its inner width may matter most. Use the available gallery to eliminate questions already answered. A focused request takes less interpretation and makes it easier to recognise whether the resulting photo actually satisfies your purpose.
corrections.translation: Prioritaskan detail yang memengaruhi keputusan menerima barang. Untuk pakaian berlapis, lebar dada rata mungkin lebih penting daripada logo. Untuk pengganti suatu bagian tas, bentuk dan lebar dalam klip mungkin menentukan. Gunakan galeri yang tersedia untuk menyingkirkan pertanyaan yang sudah terjawab.

corrections.source: Describe a location anyone can find
corrections.translation: Sebutkan lokasi yang mudah ditemukan

corrections.source: For a pair or a set, name the component as well. A request for the tongue label can produce a clear image of the right shoe while your question concerns the left. If both need checking, say so explicitly and explain what must be readable. A request for a bag buckle should specify which strap and whether the buckle should be shown open, closed or from the inside. Each detail serves an actual comparison and helps avoid a repetition of the existing overview.
corrections.translation: Untuk sepasang barang, sebutkan komponennya. Foto label lidah sepatu kanan tidak menjawab pertanyaan mengenai kiri. Jika keduanya perlu diperiksa, katakan demikian dan sebutkan tulisan yang harus terbaca. Untuk gesper tas, tentukan talinya dan apakah gesper perlu terbuka, tertutup, atau terlihat dari dalam.

corrections.source: Specify how a measurement should be taken
corrections.translation: Jelaskan cara mengambil ukuran

corrections.source: Adapt the request to realistic handling
corrections.translation: Sesuaikan permintaan dengan penanganan yang mungkin

corrections.source: Some details can be shown by rotating an item. Others require opening packaging, removing a tag or disassembling a component. Identify what the photo would require and check whether the service can perform that action. If it would affect a seal or condition important to your purchase, stop and decide whether the evidence is worth that change. A request to show a manufacturer's printed seal from the outside may answer part of the question with less handling.
corrections.translation: Sebagian detail hanya memerlukan barang diputar. Yang lain perlu membuka kemasan, melepas label, atau membongkar komponen. Tanyakan apakah layanan mengizinkannya. Bila tindakan mengubah segel atau kondisi penting, pertimbangkan dahulu. Foto segel pabrik dari luar mungkin sudah menjawab pertanyaan tanpa dibuka.

corrections.source: If the available service offers a priced photo option, check the displayed scope before using it. Confirm whether you are ordering a single image, a requested angle or another defined service. Avoid assuming that adding five unrelated instructions to one message guarantees five separate results. If you have a fixed budget for inspection, choose the detail with the greatest impact on your decision and specify what would count as a readable answer. Save the confirmation with your order evidence.
corrections.translation: Untuk layanan foto berbayar, baca cakupan yang ditampilkan. Apakah biayanya untuk satu gambar, satu sudut, atau layanan lain? Lima instruksi terpisah dalam satu pesan belum menjamin lima hasil. Jika anggaran terbatas, pilih detail yang paling menentukan dan jelaskan seperti apa foto yang berguna.

corrections.source: Evaluate the result and decide whether to follow up
corrections.translation: Nilai hasil dan tentukan apakah perlu foto lanjutan

corrections.source: Open the original result rather than judging it from a thumbnail. Check three things: whether it is the correct item, whether it shows the specified area and whether the detail is readable or measurable. If it answers your question, write down the observation and date. A concise note such as “zip opening is visible between both stops, measured across the usable gap” preserves the basis of your decision more clearly than a generic acceptance mark.
corrections.translation: Buka berkas asli, bukan hanya gambar mini. Periksa identitas barang, bagian yang diminta, dan apakah detail dapat dibaca atau diukur. Jika sudah terjawab, catat pengamatan dan tanggal. Misalnya, “kedua pembatas ritsleting terlihat dan ukuran diambil pada celah yang dapat digunakan”.

corrections.source: Preserve the starting point
corrections.translation: Simpan bukti awal

corrections.source: Save the seller option, quantity, price and original order reference. Keep the warehouse photographs that identify the problem. State the issue in terms another person could verify, such as the received size tag reading large when the paid selection was medium. A general statement that the item looks different is harder to act on when the seller page has multiple versions or a changing set of pictures.
corrections.translation: Simpan varian penjual, jumlah, harga, nomor pesanan asal, dan foto gudang yang menunjukkan masalah. Jelaskan hal yang dapat diperiksa, misalnya label barang terbaca L sedangkan pilihan yang dibayar M. Pernyataan “kelihatannya berbeda” sulit ditindaklanjuti bila ada beberapa varian atau gambar berubah.

corrections.source: Read the instructions on the actual order and ask what the seller or platform needs before the unit is moved. Note any requirement concerning packaging, tags, evidence or domestic return transport. Avoid assuming that storage time and exchange eligibility have the same deadline. A return agreement, a dispatched return and an accepted replacement are distinct events and may have separate references.
corrections.translation: Baca petunjuk pada pesanan dan tanyakan apa yang dibutuhkan sebelum barang dipindahkan. Catat syarat kemasan, label, bukti, dan ongkos kirim balik domestik. Tenggat penyimpanan dan tenggat penukaran bisa berbeda. Persetujuan pengembalian, paket balik dikirim, dan pengganti diterima adalah kejadian terpisah.

corrections.source: Retain the original warehouse entry even after the unit has left. Add the domestic tracking number if one is provided and record who supplied it. A carrier scan tells you about the physical delivery of a package. It cannot, on its own, show that a seller inspected the item, accepted the exchange or sent the replacement. Update each step only when its own evidence appears.
corrections.translation: Pertahankan entri gudang asal meski barang sudah keluar. Tambahkan resi domestik dan sumber yang memberikannya. Pemindaian kurir hanya menjelaskan pergerakan paket; belum membuktikan penjual memeriksa barang, menyetujui penukaran, atau mengirim pengganti. Perbarui tiap tahap saat tersedia buktinya sendiri.

corrections.source: Check the replacement without recycling the old pictures
corrections.translation: Periksa unit pengganti dengan foto baru

corrections.source: Give the replacement a separate line with its warehouse intake reference and photographs. Verify the precise detail that prompted the exchange and check the rest of the unit as well. A corrected colour does not establish the right size, quantity or included accessories. When the photographs look identical to the original set, ask which images belong to the new intake before treating them as fresh evidence.
corrections.translation: Buat baris baru berisi nomor penerimaan dan foto unit pengganti. Periksa detail penyebab penukaran beserta bagian lain. Warna yang sudah benar belum memastikan ukuran, jumlah, atau aksesori lengkap. Jika foto tampak identik dengan foto lama, tanyakan milik penerimaan mana sebelum menggunakannya sebagai bukti baru.

corrections.source: Record any additional charge or credit using the amount, currency and payee actually shown. Match the amounts to the relevant order rather than quietly changing the old price. The item record can be resolved once the replacement has been checked and accepted, even if a separate credit remains pending. Keep both statuses visible to avoid submitting the wrong unit for international packing.
corrections.translation: Catat biaya tambahan atau dana kembali sesuai jumlah, mata uang, dan penerima yang ditampilkan. Hubungkan transaksi ke pesanan terkait tanpa mengganti harga lama. Pemeriksaan barang dapat selesai saat pengganti diterima walau kredit masih tertunda. Tampilkan kedua status agar barang yang benar dipilih untuk kiriman internasional.

corrections.source: Define the replacement you would accept
corrections.translation: Tentukan pengganti yang bersedia Anda terima

corrections.source: Before requesting an exchange, write down the exact option that would resolve your problem. If a seller delivered a blue shirt in medium when you ordered navy in medium, the remedy may be the originally selected navy option. If you ordered medium and now decide you want large, describe that as a change of selection. The difference matters because the seller and agent need to understand what happened and what item you would accept. Preserve the original order wording in both situations.
corrections.translation: Jika Anda memesan kemeja biru dongker M tetapi menerima biru M, permintaan bisa berupa varian dongker M seperti semula. Jika Anda memesan M tetapi kini ingin L, jelaskan bahwa Anda mengubah pilihan. Penjual dan agen perlu mengetahui apa yang terjadi dan unit mana yang dapat menyelesaikannya.

corrections.source: Think through alternatives before someone offers a substitute. You might accept a larger size only if a measured chest width falls within a particular range. You might accept the same colour in a different fabric only after seeing the new specification and price. Keep these conditions private until relevant, then state them explicitly when agreeing to a change. A message saying another option is available is a proposal. Record your answer and make sure the order record or later confirmation describes the choice you actually approved.
corrections.translation: Tentukan alternatif sebelum menerima tawaran. Ukuran lebih besar mungkin cocok hanya jika lebar dada dalam rentang tertentu. Warna sama dengan bahan berbeda mungkin perlu spesifikasi dan harga dahulu. Nyatakan syarat saat menyetujui perubahan. Pesan yang menawarkan pilihan lain baru berupa usulan; simpan jawaban Anda secara terpisah.

corrections.source: Build the timeline from events
corrections.translation: Susun riwayat dari kejadian yang sudah terjadi

corrections.source: Imagine the original garment arrived on Monday. On Tuesday you requested a different size. On Wednesday the agent asked the seller whether that size was in stock. At that point, the exchange has been requested and the seller response is outstanding. An estimate of when a replacement might arrive is not evidence that the original has been sent back or another garment dispatched. Keep the latest confirmed event and the next expected event on separate lines so you can follow up with a precise question.
corrections.translation: Misalnya, pakaian pertama tiba Senin. Selasa Anda meminta ukuran lain. Rabu agen menanyakan stok kepada penjual. Saat itu permintaan sudah disampaikan, tetapi jawaban penjual masih ditunggu. Perkiraan kedatangan belum membuktikan unit pertama dikirim balik atau pengganti diberangkatkan. Pisahkan kejadian terakhir yang pasti dan langkah berikutnya.

corrections.source: Useful event fields are date, actor, item or parcel reference, action and evidence. A support reply, tracking event, payment adjustment or new warehouse photograph may each support a different line. Where a time is important, retain the time zone shown in the original record. Do not count an estimate as an elapsed deadline unless the relevant order terms or a support message establish one. If a return or exchange option is time-sensitive, ask support which deadline applies to the specific order.
corrections.translation: Catat tanggal, pihak yang bertindak, nomor barang atau paket, tindakan, dan buktinya. Balasan dukungan, pemindaian kurir, penyesuaian pembayaran, dan foto gudang dapat mendukung tahapan berbeda. Simpan zona waktu bila penting. Periksa tenggat sebenarnya pada syarat pesanan atau pesan dukungan sebelum menganggap suatu perkiraan sudah terlewati.

corrections.source: Keep outgoing and incoming tracking apart
corrections.translation: Bedakan resi keluar dan resi masuk

corrections.source: An exchange may involve an outgoing domestic parcel and an incoming replacement. They have different directions and can have different tracking references. Label each reference by direction. If an outgoing parcel shows delivered, that event can help establish that a parcel reached its domestic destination. It does not confirm that the seller inspected it, approved a replacement, dispatched the replacement or that the warehouse received the correct size. Ask about the first missing step instead of repeating the entire timeline.
corrections.translation: Paket balik domestik bergerak dari gudang ke penjual, pengganti bergerak kembali ke gudang. Beri tanda arah pada tiap resi. Status terkirim pada paket balik mendukung bahwa paket mencapai tujuan domestik. Status itu belum membuktikan pemeriksaan oleh penjual, persetujuan penukaran, pengiriman pengganti, ataupun penerimaan di gudang.

corrections.source: If a replacement is associated with a new order or warehouse number, connect it to the original using a dated note. Avoid changing the original number to the new one and losing the connection. The original record documents the paid selection and the first unit. The replacement record documents what arrived later. If the replacement is bundled with another item, make sure your note identifies which piece belongs to the exchange and which piece belongs to an unrelated purchase.
corrections.translation: Jika pengganti memperoleh nomor pesanan atau gudang baru, tautkan dengan catatan bertanggal. Simpan nomor asal sebagai bukti pilihan yang dibayar dan unit pertama. Nomor baru menjelaskan apa yang datang kemudian. Jika masuk bersama barang lain, tunjukkan komponen mana hasil penukaran.

corrections.source: Follow the money separately
corrections.translation: Telusuri pembayaran secara terpisah

corrections.source: A price difference, domestic delivery charge or service charge may be discussed during an exchange. Ask which amounts apply to the offered resolution, which currency they use and whether you need to approve them before work proceeds. A quoted amount is not a payment. Record a charge only when you see the corresponding transaction or confirmation. Likewise, a promised refund and a completed credit may appear on different dates. Tracking the money separately prevents unexplained changes to the item's original purchase price.
corrections.translation: Tanyakan selisih harga, biaya domestik, dan ongkos layanan yang berlaku, mata uang, serta kebutuhan persetujuan. Penawaran biaya belum menjadi pembayaran. Catat sebagai transaksi setelah ada konfirmasi atau mutasi. Janji pengembalian dana dan kredit yang benar-benar masuk juga dapat bertanggal berbeda.

corrections.source: Inspect the replacement as a new unit
corrections.translation: Periksa pengganti sebagai barang baru

corrections.source: When a new garment arrives, repeat the checks that triggered the exchange. A warehouse status confirming receipt does not tell you whether the new size label or measurement meets your requirement. Compare the replacement against the written agreement and the photos attached to its own intake. If the original problem involved a crooked fastening, inspect that detail on the replacement instead of relying on the original unit's photos. Also confirm the basic option and quantity so a different mistake does not slip through.
corrections.translation: Setelah barang baru tiba, ulangi pemeriksaan yang memicu penukaran. Status diterima gudang belum menunjukkan label atau ukurannya sesuai. Cocokkan dengan kesepakatan tertulis dan foto pada penerimaan baru. Jika masalah awalnya pengancing miring, periksa pengancing pada unit pengganti.

corrections.source: Once you have decided, record the result, remaining charges or credits and the warehouse reference intended for international dispatch. Check that the parcel selection uses the accepted replacement. If an old record still appears in your account, do not assume it represents an additional dispatchable item. Ask support which reference corresponds to the unit now held if anything is unclear. A completed timeline ends with a specific accepted item or another confirmed resolution and makes later parcel questions much easier to answer.
corrections.translation: Catat keputusan, biaya atau kredit tersisa, dan nomor gudang yang akan dikirim ke luar negeri. Pilih unit pengganti yang diterima pada permintaan pengemasan. Kemunculan catatan lama di akun belum berarti ada unit tambahan. Jika ragu, tanyakan nomor yang benar-benar mewakili barang di gudang.

corrections.source: Capture a useful snapshot
corrections.translation: Simpan cuplikan yang berguna

corrections.source: Save the seller page with the chosen option visible, the original option text, price, quantity and item ID. Include a date. For a set, make sure the included pieces are stated somewhere in the record. A screenshot of the hero image alone contains little information about which bundle was selected. Keep the agent purchase confirmation separately because it records the choice submitted through the order.
corrections.translation: Simpan halaman dengan varian terpilih, teks asli, harga, jumlah, itemID, dan tanggal. Untuk set, simpan daftar komponen yang dijanjikan. Foto utama saja tidak menjelaskan paket mana yang dipilih. Simpan pula konfirmasi pembelian agen secara terpisah karena dokumen itu mengidentifikasi pilihan yang benar-benar dikirim pada pesanan.

corrections.source: Identify the layer that changed
corrections.translation: Temukan bagian mana yang berubah

corrections.source: If you have not paid, treat a changed quantity or bundle as a new comparison. Recalculate the unit cost for the included contents, check current stock and review the size chart for the new option. Do not force the old cost into your new shortlist because the listing number is unchanged. If the changed term was the feature you wanted, leave the entry unresolved until the seller confirms it.
corrections.translation: Jika jumlah atau isi paket berubah sebelum dibayar, buat perbandingan baru. Hitung ulang harga per unit, cek stok sekarang, dan lihat tabel ukuran untuk pilihan baru. Kode produk yang tetap sama bukan alasan mempertahankan harga lama. Bila perubahan menyentuh fitur utama, tunggu konfirmasi penjual.

corrections.source: Compare a paid order to the agreement at payment
corrections.translation: Bandingkan dengan kesepakatan saat dibayar

corrections.source: Keep the new listing as evidence of its present state, but compare the received unit with your order-time selection. If your original record said jacket and detachable hood and the current page says jacket only, quote both versions with their dates when asking for a check. The fact that today’s page omits the hood does not independently prove what was selected earlier.
corrections.translation: Simpan halaman terbaru sebagai bukti penawaran sekarang, tetapi nilai barang yang datang berdasarkan varian saat memesan. Jika catatan lama berbunyi “jaket dan tudung lepas-pasang” lalu sekarang hanya “jaket”, sertakan kedua kutipan beserta tanggal. Ketiadaan tudung pada halaman sekarang belum membuktikan isi pilihan terdahulu.

corrections.source: Reassess historical QC references
corrections.translation: Nilai ulang foto QC lama

corrections.source: An album tied to the same marketplace identifier may show a version sold before the edit. Check the recording date, label, visible construction and package contents. Use it as a guide to the detail worth checking rather than evidence of the new offer. If your own current warehouse pictures become available, connect them to their order and option first and document any specific difference before deciding about shipping.
corrections.translation: Album dengan kode barang sama mungkin memotret versi sebelum penyuntingan. Periksa tanggal, label, konstruksi terlihat, dan isi paket. Gunakan untuk menentukan detail yang perlu ditanyakan. Saat foto pesanan sendiri tersedia, hubungkan dengan varian dan nomor pesanan lalu catat perbedaan sebelum keputusan kirim.

corrections.source: Save the offer as a dated selection
corrections.translation: Simpan penawaran sebagai pilihan bertanggal

corrections.source: A product link can continue working while its option names, photographs, price or package contents change. If a particular detail determines your choice, save that detail at the time you decide. For a travel pouch, keep the selected option wording, its dimensions, the included strap description and the quantity you are buying. A dated screenshot with the selected option and its price visible can support the note. Crop out private account information when sharing it outside the order support channel.
corrections.translation: Tautan tetap dapat dibuka meski nama, foto, harga, atau isi berubah. Saat memutuskan membeli kantong perjalanan, simpan nama pilihan, ukuran, deskripsi tali yang termasuk, dan jumlah. Foto layar bertanggal yang menunjukkan varian serta harga membantu menguatkan catatan. Potong informasi akun pribadi.

corrections.source: A seller's headline may continue to say “travel pouch with strap” when a newly added option sells the strap alone. Review the selected option and resulting subtotal instead of relying on the headline. If possible, capture both the seller's wording and your working translation. Revisit the selection just before submitting an order, particularly if it has remained in a cart for several days. A previous research note explains why you shortlisted the item; the current selection controls what you are about to submit.
corrections.translation: Judul “kantong perjalanan dengan tali” mungkin tetap ada saat penjual menambah pilihan tali saja. Periksa pilihan dan subtotal, bukan hanya judul. Simpan teks penjual serta terjemahannya. Jika barang berhari-hari berada di keranjang, tinjau lagi sesaat sebelum mengirim pesanan.

corrections.source: Distinguish a renamed option from a different offer
corrections.translation: Bedakan varian berganti nama dari penawaran baru

corrections.source: Suppose an option once called “olive large” now appears as “green B.” The names alone do not establish whether the products match. Compare the seller's current dimensions, materials, quantity and included components with the original record. If the seller displays an internal option code, compare it as additional evidence, keeping the marketplace item identifier separate. A continuing item identifier establishes the listing reference. The seller may still have changed one or more choices inside that listing.
corrections.translation: Misalnya, “zaitun besar” berubah menjadi “hijau B”. Nama belum membuktikan keduanya identik. Bandingkan ukuran, bahan, jumlah, dan komponen dengan catatan awal. Jika ada kode internal varian, bandingkan juga. Bedakan kode itu dari itemID lokapasar yang hanya mengidentifikasi halaman produk.

corrections.source: Look for the size chart heading and product diagram associated with the active option. A listing can share one gallery across multiple options, so scrolling past a familiar diagram does not always attach that diagram to your selected version. If the difference matters, ask the seller a question that identifies both old and new wording. A question about whether “green B” currently contains the large pouch and detachable strap gives a clearer target than asking whether the whole page is still the same.
corrections.translation: Periksa judul tabel ukuran dan diagram yang berlaku untuk pilihan aktif. Galeri bisa digunakan bersama oleh beberapa varian. Jika ini penting, sebutkan kedua nama saat bertanya, misalnya apakah hijau B saat ini mencakup kantong besar dan tali lepas-pasang. Simpan jawaban yang merujuk jelas pada pilihan sekarang.

corrections.source: Handle a change before you pay
corrections.translation: Tanggapi perubahan sebelum membayar

corrections.source: If you have only shortlisted the product, you can reassess its current terms without reconstructing an order dispute. Record the new option as a fresh observation, compare it with your original requirement and decide whether to keep it on your list. If the new selling unit is one pouch instead of a set of two, recalculate the quantity and subtotal before comparing it with another seller. A superficially unchanged item price can represent a different value when the number of pieces changes.
corrections.translation: Jika barang baru masuk daftar pilihan, catat kondisi baru dan bandingkan dengan kebutuhan awal. Bila satuan sekarang satu kantong, sedangkan dahulu satu set berisi dua, hitung lagi jumlah dan subtotal sebelum membandingkan penjual. Harga yang tampak sama dapat membeli isi berbeda.

corrections.source: If a selector remains ambiguous, leave the purchase pending while you investigate. A product note saying “send the old version” does not give the seller the old stock or guarantee that an agent can select it. Ask whether the precise old version is available and how to identify it in the current order flow. Preserve any answer with the date. If the response points to a different listing, treat it as a new source and check the actual option text on that listing.
corrections.translation: Jika pilihan belum jelas, tunda pembayaran sambil memeriksa. Catatan “kirim versi lama” tidak menyediakan stok lama atau menjamin agen dapat memilihnya. Tanyakan apakah versi tepat itu tersedia dan bagaimana menemukannya pada alur saat ini. Simpan jawaban bertanggal. Jika diarahkan ke halaman lain, periksa sebagai sumber baru.

corrections.source: Handle a change after payment
corrections.translation: Tanggapi perubahan setelah membayar

corrections.source: For an existing order, begin with the paid selection and confirmation, then compare the revised public offer. A listing edit alone does not establish what was ordered or what the seller shipped. If support asks whether you will accept a substitute, ask for its option wording, important differences and any price adjustment before answering. Keep your response paired with that proposal. A simple “yes” copied out of context may be difficult to interpret if multiple alternatives were discussed.
corrections.translation: Mulailah dari varian yang dibayar dan konfirmasi pesanan, kemudian bandingkan dengan halaman yang telah diperbarui. Perubahan halaman belum membuktikan apa yang dipesan atau dikirim. Jika ditawari pengganti, minta teks varian, perbedaan utama, dan penyesuaian harga. Simpan jawaban Anda bersama usulan terkait.

corrections.source: A practical support message can say that your paid order shows a large olive pouch with a detachable strap, while the current page describes green B without specifying a strap. Ask which version was purchased for your order and whether the strap is included. Provide the dated order reference privately and attach the relevant excerpts. If the answer depends on checking the incoming unit, record that as the next step and decide which warehouse photograph or contents check would settle the issue.
corrections.translation: Misalnya, pesanan mencantumkan kantong zaitun besar dengan tali lepas-pasang, sedangkan halaman kini menyebut hijau B tanpa keterangan tali. Tanyakan versi yang dibeli dan apakah tali termasuk. Beri nomor pesanan bertanggal secara pribadi beserta kutipan relevan. Bila harus menunggu barang tiba, catat langkah itu dan foto yang diperlukan.

corrections.source: Update shared finds without erasing the history
corrections.translation: Perbarui catatan bersama tanpa menghapus riwayat

corrections.source: If you share findings with others, keep the original dated note and add an update. Explain the particular change you observed and what you have yet to confirm. For example, the old label disappeared and the listing now offers green A and green B, while the correspondence with the former size remains unknown. A reader can then decide whether your older warehouse album is useful for the shape of the pouch or too uncertain for their current option decision.
corrections.translation: Pertahankan catatan awal bertanggal dan tambahkan pembaruan. Misalnya, nama lama hilang dan sekarang ada hijau A serta hijau B, tetapi hubungannya dengan ukuran lama belum diketahui. Dengan demikian orang lain dapat menilai apakah foto gudang lama masih membantu melihat bentuk kantong atau terlalu tidak pasti untuk kebutuhan sekarang.
